title: Direct observation of the Lindhard continuum using resonant inelastic X-ray scattering
abstractText: Understanding the excitations of quantum materials is essential for unraveling how their microscopic constituents interact. Among these, particle-hole excitations form a particularly important class, as they govern fundamental processes such as screening, dissipation, and transport. In metals, the continuum of electron-hole excitations is described by the Lindhard function. Although central to the theory of Fermi liquids, the corresponding Lindhard continuum has remained experimentally elusive. Here, we report its direct observation in the weakly correlated metal MgB$_{2}$ using ultra-soft resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS). We resolve a linearly dispersing excitation with velocity comparable to the Fermi velocity and find quantitative agreement with simulations of the non-interacting charge susceptibility. A detailed analysis and decomposition of the simulations reveal the intra-band origin of this low-energy excitation, confirming it as the Lindhard continuum. Our results establish ultra-soft RIXS as a momentum-resolved probe of the fermiology in metals and call for deeper investigations of continuum features in RIXS and related spectroscopy of other materials beyond MgB$_{2}$.

title: Variational Quantum-Neural Hybrid Imaginary-Time Evolution
abstractText: Numerous methodologies have been proposed to implement imaginary-time evolution (ITE) on quantum computers. Among these, variational ITE (VITE) methods for noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) computers have attracted much attention, as they use parameterized quantum circuits to mimic non-unitary dynamics. Although widely studied, conventional variational quantum algorithms face challenges in achieving high accuracy due to their strong dependence on the choice of ansatz quantum circuits. Recently, the variational quantum-neural hybrid eigensolver (VQNHE), which combines neural networks (NN) with a variational quantum eigensolver, has been proposed. This approach enhances the expressive power of variational states and improves the estimation of expectation values. Motivated by this idea, we explore the hybridization of VITE with an NN-based non-unitary operator. In this study, we propose a method named variational quantum-neural hybrid ITE (VQNHITE). By combining the NN with a parameterized quantum circuit, our proposal enhances the expressive power compared to conventional approaches, enabling more accurate tracking of imaginary-time dynamics. In addition, to mitigate the instability arising from randomly initialized NN parameters, we introduce an initial-parameter optimization procedure at a small imaginary-time step, which stabilizes the subsequent variational evolution. We tested our approach with numerical simulations on Heisenberg spin chains under both nearest-neighbor and all-to-all circuit connectivities. The results demonstrate that VQNHITE consistently achieves higher fidelity with the exact ITE state compared to VITE.

title: Programmable Non-Hermitian Synchronization of Light on a Silicon Photonic Processor
abstractText: Abstract Synchronization is a widespread collective phenomenon in which coupled units with different microscopic states evolve toward a common macroscopic order. Across these systems, dissipation plays an organizing role, suppressing microscopic differences and steering coupled units toward a coherent collective state. Here, we harness engineered dissipation in a nonunitary photonic framework to synchronize light directly in the optical domain. Implementing row-stochastic transition matrices embedded in a unitary photonic network on a silicon photonic processor, we drive generic multimode optical fields toward a unique collective state with equal modal intensities and a globally locked phase─a process we term dissipation-induced phase synchronization. The synchronization rate and total optical power throughput are independently programmable, enabling control over the dissipative dynamics without compromising reconfigurability. These results recast dissipation as a functional resource and open a route to reconfigurable on-chip synchronization for classical and quantum photonic technologies.

title: Experiment-compatible measurement-feedback quantum state preparation with reinforcement learning
abstractText: Abstract Ground-state preparation is a critical task in quantum simulation and quantum computing, as it enables the study of correlated phases and the generation of entangled resource states. While measurement–feedback control has emerged as a promising route to state preparation, existing schemes either rely on handcrafted, task-specific policies or are designed using full quantum-state information that is unavailable in real experiments and becomes impractical for large many-body systems. Here we develop an adaptive measurement–feedback protocol based on reinforcement learning under partial observability. The controller uses only the history of experimentally accessible measurement outcomes to choose both the measurement operator and the feedback action in real time. To make training compatible with experiments, we introduce a stochastic terminal reward built from one-shot measurements of randomly sampled Hamiltonian components, avoiding unphysical full-state reconstruction while remaining an unbiased estimator of the target energy. We demonstrate the method by preparing ground states of the Bose–Hubbard model and by generating GHZ states, establishing a scalable and hardware-compatible route to quantum state preparation.

title: Hyperparameter Optimization of Random Forest for Multiclass Classification of Student Academic Performance Using Multidimensional Factors
abstractText: Classification for academic performances among students in a multi-class scenario is a challenging task due to its dependencies on multiple factors and characteristics, particularly in the medium academic performance category. This scenario makes it a problem for some models with their conventional settings in terms of their ability to optimally distinguish categories of academic performances while being used in classification tasks, thus leading to the need for optimization techniques in enhancing their performances. This research paper will design an optimization strategy for improving the performances of the Random Forest algorithm in a multi-class academic performance classification among students. This will help in enhancing decision-making systems in education. The research method used is a machine learning approach with a Random Forest algorithm optimized through hyperparameter tuning using RandomizedSearchCV. This study utilizes secondary student data obtained from the Kaggle public repository, consisting of 6,607 data points with 20 determining factors covering academic, behavioral, social, environmental, and health aspects. The results showed that Random Forest hyperparameter optimization was able to improve model performance from a baseline accuracy of 79.56% to 81.08% on the validation data, and achieved an accuracy of 81.69% on the test data. In addition, there was an improvement in performance in the Medium category classification, as indicated by an increase in the F1-score value from 0.69 to 0.72. Therefore, the optimization of Random Forest proved to be good in enhancing the performance and stability of multiclass classification of student academic performance.

title: Visual Trend Analysis of E-Commerce Thumbnails Using Parallel Computing for Image Big Data
abstractText: The rapid growth of e-commerce platforms has led to the massive accumulation of product thumbnail images, making manual visual analysis inefficient and conventional sequential processing methods insufficient to handle such data volumes in a timely manner. Given the crucial role of thumbnails in influencing consumer purchasing decisions, computational strategies are required to accelerate the analysis process without compromising classification accuracy. This study applies a parallel computing approach combined with deep learning to improve the efficiency of visual trend analysis using two primary datasets: 2,608 images for model training and validation, and 40,254 images for large-scale inference. The proposed framework integrates parallel image preprocessing on multi-core CPUs, the development of a Convolutional Neural Network based on MobileNetV2 using a transfer learning approach, and batch-based parallel inference on GPUs. The developed model demonstrates stable and convergent performance, achieving a training accuracy of 0.85 and a validation accuracy of 0.83. Efficiency testing during the preprocessing stage shows that the parallel approach is more effective under large data workloads, providing a speed improvement of up to 1.58×. During the inference stage, predictions for 500 images can be completed in 1.84 seconds compared to 41.76 seconds using the sequential method, resulting in a significant computational speedup of 22.8×. Big data analysis reveals a polarization of visual strategies, where technology product categories are dominated by infographic-style thumbnails, fashion categories rely heavily on human model representations, and household product categories emphasize clean product visuals supported by promotional elements. This study concludes that the application of parallel computing significantly enhances the efficiency and scalability of visual big data analysis in e-commerce and supports more operational and strategic mapping of visual trends.

title: Implementasi Metode VIsekriterijumsko KOmpromisno Rangiranje dalam Sistem Pendukung Keputusan Identifikasi Keluarga Berisiko Stunting
abstractText: Stunting remains a significant chronic nutritional problem in Palembang City, where the identification and management of families at risk of stunting are still conducted manually, potentially leading to inaccuracies and delays in decision-making. This condition results in suboptimal interventions for the targeted families. This study utilizes a dataset comprising 400 families obtained from the Palembang City Office of Population and Family Planning (DPPKB) in 2024 as the basis for developing a Decision Support System (DSS). The method applied is VIse Kriterijumska Optimizacija Kompromisno Resenje (VIKOR), one of the approaches in Multi-Criteria Decision Making (MCDM) that can objectively integrate various risk-determining factors. The main criteria used include sources of drinking water, sanitation facilities, categories of couples of childbearing age, and participation in the Family Planning program. The results show that the family coded E obtained the highest index value of 1.00, categorized as high stunting risk, while the family coded B scored 0.00, indicating a low-risk level. The developed system is capable of providing more accurate and objective rankings of at-risk families, thereby assisting the DPPKB in determining precise intervention priorities. Thus, the implementation of the VIKOR method in this decision support system makes an important contribution to enhancing the effectiveness of stunting reduction acceleration programs in Palembang City. The contribution of this research lies in the application of the VIKOR method to support data-driven policies for accelerating stunting reduction in Palembang City.

title: Berry-Curvature Effect in Anomalous Transport
abstractText: Abstract A theory of the Berry-phase effect in anomalous transport in ferromagnets driven by statistical forces such as the gradient of temperature or chemical potential has been developed by Di Xiao et al in Phys. Rev. Lett. 97 , 026603 (2006) based on a field-dependent density of states generating an additional contribution to the current density. We present an alternative derivation of the Berry-phase effect in anomalous transport in altermagnets and noncentrosymmertric metals based on quasiclassic matrix kinetic equation. Along with anomalous Hall effect an anomalous heat flow and anomalous thermalelectric currents are derived.

title: Spiking Neural Network-Based Neuromorphic Signal Processing for Real-Time Audio Event Detection in Low-Power Embedded Smart Sensors
abstractText: The following paper presents the design of a spiking neural network (SNN) based neuromorphic signal processing system that can be used in low power embedded smart sensors to perform real time detection of audio events. In this regard, the aim is to overcome the shortcomings of traditional deep learning frameworks that are both computationally heavy and demanding in terms of power consumption such that they are incompatible with battery-run or energy-limited edge devices. Citing the performance of biological neural systems, the presented framework should utilize event-driven SNNs executed on neuromorphic platforms to identify notable acoustic situations (like alarms, speech commands and ambient environmental sounds). The architecture envisages audio preprocessing part, audio spike encoding, and spike temporally contrast encoding or Poisson encoding, and a multi-layer core SNN trained by surrogate gradient descent. The model is tuned to run on an Intel Loihi and ARM Cortex-M7 microcontroller. The standard datasets were used to assess the performance, such as Google Speech Commands, ESC-10 and UrbanSound8K. Using the experimental results, it can be proven that the SNN-based model has up to 92.7% correct classification accuracy, using < 5mW power with a latency below 20 milliseconds. SNN approach is equivalent in accuracy to conventional CNN baselines in many cases with much lower energy consumption. Results confirm the prospect of SNNs at ultra-low-power, real-time signal processing in future generation edge-AI acoustic systems. The research directions will look at hardware-aware training and learning that can be used to improve on adaptability and scalability of embedded smart sensing systems.

title: Empowerment of Islamic Religious Education Teachers through Generative AI Training for the Development of Islamic Value-Based Learning Media at SMP Negeri 35 Medan
abstractText: The development of artificial intelligence (AI) technology, particularly Generative AI, has created new opportunities for developing innovative, interactive, and contextual learning media. However, many Islamic Religious Education (IRE) teachers still have limited competencies in utilizing this technology as a learning medium while maintaining Islamic values. This Community Service Program (PKM) aimed to improve the competence of IRE teachers at SMP Negeri 35 Medan in utilizing Generative AI to develop creative, effective, and Islamic value-based learning media. The program employed a Participatory Action Learning approach consisting of needs identification, educational sessions, practical training, mentoring, and evaluation. The training involved demonstrations and hands-on practice using various Generative AI platforms, including ChatGPT, Canva AI, Gamma AI, and Microsoft Copilot, to develop teaching materials, presentations, assessment questions, and visual learning media based on Islamic values. The results indicated an improvement in participants' understanding of Generative AI, enhanced skills in developing digital learning media, and increased awareness of the ethical use of AI from an Islamic perspective. The teachers were able to produce learning media that were more engaging, interactive, contextual, and supportive of the implementation of the Merdeka Curriculum. This program contributed positively to improving teachers' digital literacy while strengthening the integration of technology and Islamic values in the IRE learning process.

title: Improving Teachers' Competence In Designing AI-Assisted Learning Media At Yayasan Rahmat Islamiyah Medan
abstractText: This community service program was conducted to improve teachers' competence in designing Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted learning media at Yayasan Rahmat Islamiyah, Medan. The program was motivated by the gap between the rapid development of AI-based educational technology and the limited digital pedagogical capacity of teachers in many Islamic educational foundations, which still rely on conventional, text-based teaching media. Teachers at the foundation faced difficulties in producing communicative visual, audio-visual, presentation, and video-based learning media, as well as in building effective communication with young learners. The program was carried out through four stages adapted from the management cycle of planning, organizing, actuating, and controlling, followed by an evaluation stage using Kirkpatrick's four-level model. Activities included lectures, hands-on workshops, mentoring, and simulation of AI tool usage such as Canva AI, CapCut AI, and presentation-generation platforms, grounded in the Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge framework. Results show a significant increase in teachers' knowledge and skills, reflected in pre-test and post-test scores, active participation, and the production of AI-assisted teaching media by all participants. Teachers also reported improved confidence in communicating with children through more engaging, visualized instructional content. This PKM concludes that structured, AI-based media-design training effectively strengthens teacher competence and can serve as a sustainable model for continuous professional development in Islamic educational foundations facing similar digital transformation challenges.

title: Strengthening Financial Literacy and Marketing Skills among Students through a Thematic Community Engagement Program
abstractText: This community service activity was part of a Thematic Community Service Program (Kuliah Kerja Nyata/KKN) aimed at strengthening students’ financial literacy and marketing skills as a foundation for introducing entrepreneurship. The activity involved 32 tenth-grade students at SMA Kemala Bhayangkari in Bandung City, Indonesia. An educational-participatory approach was employed through basic accounting instruction, interactive quizzes using Kahoot!, demonstrations, and sales pitch simulations. The financial literacy materials covered debit and credit, the basic accounting equation, and simple cash flow, while the marketing materials focused on product features and benefits, hooks, and calls to action. Evaluation was conducted through quiz results and observations of students’ engagement and practical performance. Students participated in the quizzes with scores ranging from 0% to 80%, while all participants were given the opportunity to engage in the educational and marketing practice sessions. The activity provided students with an applied learning experience in understanding the fundamentals of financial management and marketing communication, thereby contributing to the development of their entrepreneurial competencies.

title: Hadith Literacy Training for Young People to Enhance Critical Religious Understanding
abstractText: Hadith literacy is an essential competency for young people in understanding Islamic teachings critically and contextually. The development of digital technology and social media has facilitated access to various sources of religious information while simultaneously increasing the risk of disseminating unauthentic hadiths, developing textual understandings, and promoting inaccurate religious interpretations. This Community Service (PkM) activity aimed to enhance young people's ability to understand, trace, verify, and interpret hadiths critically and contextually. The activity employed a Participatory Action Learning approach consisting of needs assessment, material delivery, practical hadith tracing, critical discussions, mentoring, and evaluation. The training materials covered the introduction to hadith sources, classification of hadith authenticity, takhrij al-hadith methods, verification of digital sources, contextual understanding of hadith, and ethical practices in disseminating religious information through social media. The results indicated an improvement in participants' understanding of how to identify hadith sources and assess their authenticity, as well as their ability to distinguish between reliable religious information and information requiring further verification. The training also encouraged participants to become more critical, reflective, and responsible in consuming and disseminating hadith-related information in digital spaces. Therefore, hadith literacy training can serve as an educational strategy for strengthening critical, moderate, and credible religious understanding among young people.

title: Integrating Artificial Intelligence And Personality Traits Into The Theory Of Planned Behavior: Driving Shariah Compliant Investment Decisions
abstractText: This study aims to examine a structural framework integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Personality Traits into the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) model, with intention acting as a mediating variable on Shariah investment decisions among Generation Z in Indonesia. Data analysis was conducted using a quantitative approach with Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). The results indicate that TPB has a positive and significant effect on investment intention. Intention also strongly mediates the relationship between TPB and investment decisions and has a significant direct impact on actual investment decisions. Conversely, AI and Personality Traits do not significantly influence investment intention, and intention fails to mediate the effect of these variables on investment decisions. The study concludes that for Generation Z investors, external stimuli, social trends, and platform accessibility reflected in the TPB model dominate the decision-making process far more than intrinsic personality factors or pure AI algorithmic features that lack human validation for Shariah compliance. Therefore, the Islamic capital market industry is advised to prioritize the development of social ecosystems and user-friendly application designs.

title: Training on Strengthening Religious Moderation Values Based on Hadith for the Community
abstractText: This Community Service (PkM) program, entitled “Training on Strengthening Religious Moderation Values Based on Hadith for the Community,” aims to strengthen participants’ understanding and application of religious moderation values based on prophetic traditions in everyday social life. The program employed a participatory approach consisting of needs assessment, interactive lectures, thematic hadith discussions, case studies, group discussions, practical activities, mentoring, and evaluation. The training focused on prophetic values related to tawassuth (moderation), tasamuh (tolerance), i‘tidal (justice), tawazun (balance), respect for differences, brotherhood, compassion, and peaceful coexistence. Participants were guided to identify relevant hadith, understand their meanings, examine their contextual relevance, and apply their messages to contemporary social and religious issues. The results indicated that the training enhanced participants’ understanding of religious moderation and increased their awareness of the importance of applying prophetic values in responding to religious diversity. Participants also demonstrated greater critical awareness in addressing differences in religious interpretation and religious information circulating through digital media. The program concludes that hadith-based religious moderation training can serve as an effective strategy for strengthening community religious literacy, promoting tolerance, and building peaceful and harmonious social relations.

title: COMPARATIVE CONCEPTUAL STUDY OF NAGARADI CHURNA AND BHUNIMBADI CHURNA IN PITTAJA GRAHANI
abstractText: Background: Grahani is a disease of impaired Agni and its seat, the Grahani. Pittaja Grahani arises when aggravated Pitta, with its increased Drava Guna, weakens Agni. Classical texts prescribe Shodhana followed by Tikta Rasa Churna and medicated Ghrita. Nagaradi Churna and Bhunimbadi Churna are two such Churna formulations described under Pittaja Grahani, yet their stage-wise application is not clearly distinguished. Aim: To conceptually analyse and compare the therapeutic rationale of Nagaradi Churna and Bhunimbadi Churna in Pittaja Grahani with reference to the Avastha of the disease. Materials and Methods: This conceptual literary study drew on the Brihattrayi and Laghutrayi with commentaries, Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Dravya-Guna-Shastram and Charaka Kalpa Sudha. Contemporary literature was searched in PubMed, DHARA and Google Scholar. The ingredients, Rasapanchaka, Karma, Anupana and Phalashruti of both formulations were compiled and compared. Discussion: Nagaradi Churna has a predominance of Tikta-Katu Rasa and Ruksha Guna, and shows Deepana-Pachana, Grahi, Raktaprasadana and Vatanulomana actions, with Madhu and Tandulodaka as Anupana. Bhunimbadi Churna is dominated by Kutaja (about two-thirds of the formulation) and is Tikta, Shita and Ruksha, acting through Drava-shoshana and Vibandha-nashana, with Guda-Shitambu as Anupana. Conclusion: Nagaradi Churna appears more suitable when Raktapravartana, Vibandha or Avaruddha Vata is present. Bhunimbadi Churna appears more suitable when Raktapravartana is absent, in Dravapradhana Pitta and in Shakhagata Pitta. Both formulations may be used for Pachana in Sama Avastha by changing the Anupana.

title: SHORT BOWEL SYNDROME THROUGH THE LENS OF GRAHANI ROGA: AN INTEGRATIVE REVIEW OF PATHOPHYSIOLOGY AND MANAGEMENT
abstractText: Background: Short Bowel Syndrome (SBS) is a complex malabsorptive state resulting from extensive surgical resection of small intestine, usually <200 cm of remaining bowel. It presents with chronic diarrhoea, steatorrhea, dehydration, malnutrition, and dependence on Total Parenteral Nutrition (TPN). Modern management is limited to supportive care and intestinal adaptation with GLP-2 analogues. In Ayurveda, a similar syndrome with altered bowel function, malabsorption and deranged Agni is described as Grahani Roga. Aim: To establish conceptual correlation between SBS and Grahani Roga and to explore Ayurvedic management principles for integrative care of SBS. Materials & Methods: Classical Ayurvedic texts and modern literature were reviewed. Results: SBS shows close resemblance to vataja and sannipataja grahani with mandagni and ama. Symptoms like muhurbaddha muhur drava mala pravritti (intermittent loose and formed stools), atisrushta mala, trishna, daurbalya correlate with SBS. Principles of deepana, pachana, grahi, stambhana and takra prayoga offer potential for enhancing intestinal adaptation. Conclusion: SBS can be understood as a grahani-dushti vikara. An integrative approach centered on agni deepana and grahi chikitsa may help in reducing TPN dependence and improving nutritional status.

title: A CASE REPORT ON SCLERITIS MANAGED WITH AYURVEDIC INTERVENTION ABSTRACT
abstractText: This article presents an integrative Ayurvedic therapeutic regimen for the management of ocular disorders, emphasizing both internal medication and external ocular therapies. The internal treatment protocol includes Manjishthadi Kwatha (20 ml twice daily after meals with water) for its raktashodhana and anti-inflammatory properties; Triphala Ghrita (10 ml twice daily after meals with milk) to nourish ocular tissues and balance doshas; and Shiva Gutika, administered twice daily after meals with lukewarm water, for its rasayana and immunomodulatory effects. External therapies consist of Netramritam Eye Drops (one drop in both eyes twice daily) to alleviate ocular irritation and maintain ocular surface health, and Netra Parisheka with Triphala Kwatha once daily for cleansing, cooling, and strengthening of the eyes. This holistic approach reflects classical Ayurvedic principles, combining systemic and local therapies to promote ocular health and prevent disease progression.

title: Continuous-Flow Photochemical Nitrile Imine Cycloadditions with Cyclopropenes: Access to Substituted Pyrazoles
abstractText: Abstract Herein, we report a general continuous-flow photochemical protocol for the synthesis of highly substituted pyrazoles through the reaction of tetrazoles with cyclopropenes. The methodology combines monochromatic 308 nm UV-B LED irradiation with continuous-flow processing, providing short residence times, operational simplicity, and gram-scale preparation under safe reaction conditions. A broad range of tetrazoles and cyclopropenes were successfully converted into the corresponding pyrazoles, while selected aryl-substituted cyclopropenes afforded isolable bicyclic cycloadducts. The spontaneous conversion of one of these intermediates into the corresponding pyrazole provides experimental support for the proposed cycloaddition/ring opening sequence. Overall, this work extends the synthetic utility of tetrazole-derived nitrile imines and establishes cyclopropenes as versatile dipolarophiles for the preparation of substituted pyrazoles.

title: ANALISIS SENTIMEN PENGGUNA APLIKASI SHOPEE BERBASIS LONG SHORT-TERM MEMORY (LSTM) DAN WORD EMBEDDING
abstractText: Dalam era digital saat ini, aplikasi mobile telah menjadi bagian utama dalam kehidupan sehari-hari yang mendukung berbagai aktivitas, seperti belanja, hiburan, dan komunikasi. Salah satu sektor yang berkembang pesat adalah e-commerce, dimana Shopee merupakan salah satu platform yang populer dan banyak digunakan oleh masyarakat Indonesia. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis sentimen ulasan pengguna aplikasi Shopee menggunakan metode Word2Vec dan Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). Data yang digunakan sebanyak 6.000 ulasan berbahasa Indonesia yang dikumpulkan melalui web scraping dari Google Play Store. Proses dilanjutkan melalui tahapan cleaning text, case folding, normalization, penghapusan kata duplikat, stopword removal, dan stemming. Data kemudian diberi label sentimen positif, negatif, dan netral menggunakan Inset Lexicon. Model LSTM menghasilkan akurasi sebesar 85,08%, precision 84,08%, recall 85,08%, dan F1-score 84,18%. Performa terbaik pada sentimen positif, namun masih terdapat kesalahan pada sentimen negatif dan netral akibat ketidakseimbangan data. Hasil ini menunjukkan bahwa Word2Vec dan LSTM dapat digunakan pada analisis sentimen ulasan aplikasi e-commerce terutama dalam mengklasifikasi sentimen positif.

title: PERBANDINGAN IMPLEMENTASI PROGRAM TAHFIDZ AL-QUR’AN PADA SISTEM ASRAMA DAN PULANG HARI DI SMP IT AL UMM SMART CENTRE
abstractText: Abstrak Penelitian ini menguji bagaimana satu kurikulum tahfidz Al-Qur’an diimplementasikan pada dua konfigurasi layanan, yaitu program asrama (boarding) dan program pulang hari (full-day), di SMP IT Al Umm Smart Centre, Sumatera Utara. Penelitian kualitatif ini menggunakan desain studi kasus tunggal dengan beberapa unit analisis (embedded single-case study). Data dikumpulkan melalui wawancara mendalam, observasi lapangan, dan studi dokumen dari 15 partisipan terpilih (1 Kepala Sekolah, 1 Koordinator Tahfidz/Guru Tahfidz, 1 Guru Tahfidz, 1 Musyrif Asrama, 6 siswa asrama, dan 6 siswa pulang hari, lalu dianalisis menggunakan teknik analisis data kualitatif model interaktif. Temuan penelitian mengindikasikan bahwa kedua program berbagi visi kelembagaan, kerangka akademik, dan kriteria mutu kelulusan yang sama, namun berbeda pada alokasi target kuantitatif hafalan, struktur waktu, alur pengawasan, dan lingkungan sosial. Metode tahfidz yang digunakan secara formal identik pada kedua program. Keterkaitan perbedaan capaian hafalan yang dilaporkan informan tampak berkaitan dengan konteks implementasi, terutama alur tanggung jawab pengawasan dan alokasi waktu pembinaan. Informan melaporkan volume hafalan dan kesiapan setoran yang lebih tinggi pada siswa asrama, namun hal ini dipengaruhi oleh motivasi awal siswa, perbedaan beban target, serta keterbatasan penilaian kelancaran (itqan) yang bersifat kualitatif-subjektif. Sebagai kontribusi pemikiran, penelitian ini merumuskan Model Manajemen Tahfidz Adaptif Empat Lapis yang berbasis kemitraan sekolah–keluarga. Model ini merupakan usulan konseptual yang dikembangkan dari analisis kasus dan masih memerlukan pengujian empiris lanjutan untuk menilai efektivitasnya pada program pulang hari. Kata Kunci: Tahfidz Al-Qur’an; Program Asrama; Program Pulang Hari; Implementasi Tahfidz; Pengawasan Pembelajaran; Kemitraan Sekolah–Keluarga. Abstract This study examines how a single tahfidz Al-Qur’an curriculum is implemented under two service delivery configurations, namely the boarding and full-day programs, at SMP IT Al Umm Smart Centre, North Sumatra. This qualitative research employed an embedded single-case study design. Data were collected through in-depth interviews, field observations, and document analysis involving 15 purposively selected participants (1 Principal, 1 Tahfidz Coordinator/Teacher, 1 Tahfidz Teacher, 1 Dormitory Supervisor, 6 boarding students, and 6 full-day students, and analyzed using interactive qualitative data analysis techniques. Findings indicate that both programs share the same institutional vision, academic framework, and graduation quality standards, yet differ in quantitative memorization targets, time structure, supervision accountability chains, and social environment. The formal memorization methods used are identical across both programs. Variations in memorization progress reported by informants appear to be associated with implementation context, particularly the supervision chain and time allocation. Informants reported higher memorization volume and daily readiness among boarding students; however, these reported outcomes were influenced by initial student motivation, differing target baselines, and the subjective nature of fluency (itqan) evaluations. As a conceptual contribution, this study proposes a Four-Layer Adaptive Tahfidz Management Model based on school–family partnerships. This model serves as a conceptual proposition derived from case analysis and requires further empirical testing to evaluate its effectiveness in full-day programs. Keywords: Qur’an memorization; boarding program; full-day program; tahfidz implementation; learning supervision; school–family partnership.

title: Tinjauan Hukum Peran Bawaslu Provinsi dan Dewan Kehormatan Penyelenggara Pemilu (DKPP) Sebagai Tim Pemeriksa Daerah Dalam Pelanggaran Kode Etik Penyelenggara Pemilu
abstractText: bstrak: Penelitian ini bertema konstruksi normatif kedudukan, batas kewenangan, dan independensi Tim Pemeriksa Daerah (TPD) dalam pengawasan etik penyelenggara pemilu di Indonesia serta implikasinya terhadap prinsip Hukum Administrasi Negara. Metode penelitian yang digunakan bersifat normatif yuridis melalui studi pustaka terhadap peraturan perundang-undangan, literatur akademik, dan dokumentasi hukum, dengan pendekatan statute, konsep, dan interpretatif untuk menganalisis norma hukum yang mengatur Bawaslu, DKPP, dan TPD. Fokus penelitian mencakup permasalahan konflik kepentingan dalam komposisi keanggotaan TPD, penerapan asas ketidakberpihakan, akuntabilitas, serta profesionalitas dalam mekanisme pemeriksaan etik. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa pembentukan TPD memiliki dasar hukum melalui “Undang-Undang Nomor 7 Tahun 2017” dan “Peraturan DKPP Nomor 5 Tahun 2017” sehingga memenuhi asas legalitas administratif, tetapi komposisi kelembagaan yang melibatkan unsur Bawaslu dan KPU berpotensi menimbulkan konflik kepentingan serta bias institusional karena pemeriksa berasal dari lembaga yang diawasi. Penelitian juga menemukan bahwa akuntabilitas administratif pemeriksaan etik belum optimal karena kurangnya mekanisme pelaporan yang terbuka dan kejelasan pertanggungjawaban, serta profesionalitas pemeriksa masih beragam karena standar kompetensi yang belum seragam. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa efektivitas dan kredibilitas TPD masih menghadapi hambatan signifikan serta menegaskan kebutuhan penguatan regulasi, pemisahan fungsi pemeriksa etik dari lembaga penyelenggara, serta peningkatan kapasitas teknis untuk menjamin integritas pengawasan pemilu sesuai prinsip Hukum Administrasi Negara.

title: Paraneoplastic Autoimmune Multiorgan Syndrome: Diagnostic Lessons for Pediatricians
abstractText: We report the challenging diagnosis of an 11-year-old boy, presenting with subacute erythroblastopenia, followed by a multisystemic immune-mediated syndrome characterized by polymorphic mucocutaneous manifestations, associated with severe myositis related to a dermatomyositis-like phenotype and mild hepatitis. A progressive lymphadenopathy led to a delayed diagnosis of T-lymphoblastic lymphoma associated with paraneoplastic autoimmune multiorgan syndrome. To achieve remission of this paraneoplastic syndrome, Janus kinase inhibitor was required in addition to antitumor therapy. This case highlights several key points: (1) Pediatricians should consider a paraneoplastic origin when facing juvenile dermatomyositis with atypical features, such as hematologic and mucosal abnormalities; (2) in uncertain cases, early collaboration with oncologists is needed to optimize diagnostic and therapeutic strategies; (3) the choice of immunomodulatory therapy is critical in addition to antitumor therapy.

title: Analysis of Clean Water Demand in Telawang District, East Kotawaringin Regency
abstractText: Access to clean water is a fundamental community need that requires careful planning based on population growth and the capacity of existing water supply infrastructure. Telawang District, East Kotawaringin Regency, continues to face limitations in clean water services, as the existing non-PDAM water supply system serving the Ibu Kota Kecamatan (IKK, district administrative center) has a production capacity of only 10 L/s and serves 394 household connections, equivalent to approximately 1,576 people or 9.6% of the total population of 16,397. This study aimed to project population growth and estimate clean water demand to support the development of the Drinking Water Supply System (Sistem Penyediaan Air Minum, SPAM) within the Sebabi IKK service area, particularly Sebabi Village and Sumber Makmur Village. Data were collected through official documents and field surveys, while population projections were calculated using the geometric growth method in accordance with relevant water supply planning guidelines. The results indicated that the combined peak-hour water demand was projected to increase from 11.39 L/s in 2023 to 37.39 L/s in 2032 and 67.73 L/s in 2043. To meet the projected demand through 2032, the estimated raw water flow requirement was 35 L/s, which was increased to a design capacity of 40 L/s to account for pumping efficiency, while the proposed water treatment plant capacity was 35 L/s. The study concluded that projected population growth would substantially increase clean water demand, highlighting the need to expand SPAM infrastructure and align production and distribution capacities with future service requirements.

title: The Origins of the German V-2 Rocket: How Military and Technological Traditions Shaped an Armament Revolution
abstractText: Abstract From 1930, strategists of the German Army Ordnance Office discussed a new armament scenario. The visionary technology of rocket propulsion was intended to create a weapon that should compensate the Reichswehr’s military deficit all at once. This idea followed two imperatives: the bellicose one, that the disgrace of the lost First World War could only be made up for by a new war; and the technological one, that only a leading technical position would bring military success. The beginnings of the project were modest. But soon, the effort grew enormously, and the project became “too big to fail” when a big science centre was constructed in Peenemünde from 1936. The German armaments strategy was guided by a belief in invention, which ended in a total air war. The early stage of the rocket project formed a hinge between armaments planning in the First and the Second World War.

Forecasting Next-Day TLKM Stock Prices Using Linear and Nonlinear Machine Learning Models: A Case Study of PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk
abstractText: Stock price forecasting provides useful information for investors in making decisions in fluctuating capital markets. The objective of this work is to develop and compare models to forecast the closing price for the next trading day. Three models were employed: linear regression, an optimized random forest regression, and an optimized backpropagation neural network. The dataset used consists of daily market data for TLKM and IHSG covering the period from March 22, 2018, to February 24, 2027. The predictors used include open price, high price, low price, trading volume, SMA5, and RSI14, while the target variable is the next day's TLKM closing price. The dataset was divided chronologically into 80% training and 20% testing sets. Time-series cross-validation was performed using 5-fold TimeSeriesSplit. Hyperparameter optimization was applied to the random forest and backpropagation neural network models using RandomizedSearchCV. The results show that linear regression outperforms the other models based on the overall evaluation metrics, with an MAE of 57.67, RMSE of 81.38, MAPE of 1.37%, and of 92.8%. The MAPE value indicates that the linear regression model has a relatively low forecasting error. The linear regression model can also explain approximately 92.8% of the variation in the next day's TLKM closing price through the predictors included in the model. The implication of this work is that a linear regression model can provide an additional quantitative reference for investors in evaluating the possibility of TLKM closing price movements on the next trading day.

title: Correlation of Depression Levels and Emotional Eating Behavior with Energy Intake in Elderly
abstractText: The increasing number of elderly people in Indonesia presents various challenges, especially in the areas of physical and mental health. One of the common issues that often arises is depression and changes in eating behavior, which have the potential to affect daily energy intake. Older adults with unstable psychological conditions tend to experience disruptions in their eating patterns, including decreased appetite or increased food consumption as a response to negative emotions. This study aimed to analyze the relationship between depression levels and emotional eating behavior with energy intake among elderly individuals at Paguyuban Lansia Srikandi, Kelurahan Kapasari, Surabaya.The study employed an analytic observational design with a cross-sectional approach. A total of 69 elderly respondents were selected using a simple random sampling technique. Data were collected using the Geriatric Depression Scale (GDS), the Dutch Eating Behavior Questionnaire (DEBQ), and a Repeated 24-Hour Food Recall form over three days (two weekdays and one weekend). The data were analyzed using univariate and bivariate methods with the Spearman Rank test.The results showed that some elderly respondents experienced mild to severe depression (49.3%) and exhibited high levels of emotional eating behavior (50.7%). Additionally, 44.9% of the elderly were recorded as having insufficient energy intake. The conclusion of this study is that there is a significant relationship between the level of depression and energy intake, with a p-value of 0.016, and also a significant relationship between emotional eating and energy intake, with a p-value of 0.004. It is recommended that older adults receive ongoing psychological support and nutrition education to prevent nutritional problems caused by emotional instability. Keywords: elderly, depression level, emotional eating behavior, energy intake

title: PELATIHAN GURU SEKOLAH DASAR BERBASIS CAKRA-21 UNTUK MENDORONG TRANSFORMASI PEMBELAJARAN ABAD 21 DAN LITERASI AI
abstractText: Transformasi pendidikan abad ke-21 menuntut guru sekolah dasar menguasai Computational Thinking (CT), coding, dan Artificial Intelligence (AI), namun kesiapan guru di Kabupaten Bangka masih terkendala oleh rendahnya kompetensi pedagogis, kompetensi digital, dan kurangnya pengalaman pelatihan. Kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini bertujuan meningkatkan kompetensi guru melalui pelatihan berbasis Model CAKRA-21 yang mengintegrasikan CT, coding, dan AI dalam lima fase pembelajaran: Cermati, Alurkan, Kodekan, Rasio-Refleksi, dan Aksi. Pelatihan dilaksanakan selama tiga hari (11–13 Juni 2026) di Aula Dinas Pendidikan Kabupaten Bangka dengan melibatkan 21 guru dari Sungailiat, Pemali, dan Bakam melalui pendekatan participatory training yang mencakup workshop, praktik unplugged dan plugged activities, microteaching, serta pendampingan penyusunan perangkat pembelajaran. Hasil evaluasi menunjukkan peningkatan rata-rata nilai peserta dari 63,24 pada pre-test menjadi 89,52 pada post-test atau meningkat 41,56%, dengan nilai N-Gain sebesar 0,72 yang tergolong kategori tinggi. Seluruh peserta berhasil menyusun Rencana Pelaksanaan Pembelajaran berbasis Model CAKRA-21 dan memberikan respons sangat positif terhadap materi serta metode pelatihan. Peserta juga menyatakan kesiapan mengimplementasikan pembelajaran berbasis CT, coding, dan AI di sekolah masing-masing. Kegiatan ini membuktikan bahwa Model CAKRA-21 efektif sebagai kerangka sistematis untuk meningkatkan kompetensi guru dalam mengintegrasikan teknologi digital pada pembelajaran abad ke-21 di sekolah dasar.

CALF-20-Based Porous Liquids for Enhanced SO2 Capture
abstractText: Abstract Currently, efforts are being made to develop desulfurization technologies featuring high desulfurization efficiency, renewable desulfurizers, and low corrosivity. In this study, a comparative study was conducted of SO2 capture by ten kinds of metal–organic framework (MOF)-based porous liquids. Calgary framework-20 (CALF-20)/poly(ethylene glycol) dimethyl ether (NHD) with pore width of 5.2 Å × 5.7 Å are found to be optimal for SO2 capture, exhibiting an a(b)dsorption capacity of 0.12 mol/L under 0.1 bar. The selectivity of SO2/N2 and SO2/CO2 achieves 562 and 51, respectively, and the uptake enthalpy for SO2 is only 30.44 kJ·mol–1. Furthermore, after multiple breakthrough experiments, the uptake still remained unchanged. Meanwhile, process simulations were conducted; when SO2 mol % (≥99.95%) is in the product gas, the capture work is only 0.946 GJ/t SO2. Additionally, the saturated CALF-20-based porous liquids exhibited low corrosivity to carbon steels even after being immersed for 60 days; this anticorrosive absorbent reveals the potential for industrial SO2 capture.

title: A Hybrid Fuzzy–Neural Decision-Support Framework for Graduate Learning Outcome Attainment Evaluation in a Computer Science Program
abstractText: A passing threshold of 70 assigns different attainment labels to students scoring 71.0 and 66.5, although both are close enough to warrant review. This study develops a fuzzy-neural decision-support framework for graduate learning outcome assessment in an undergraduate Computer Science program. Weighted course learning outcome scores determine the reference status. Fuzzy rules provide category memberships and a soft score, with cases within five points of 70 referred to a human reviewer. A single-layer perceptron produces a separate estimate from normalized course scores. Four anonymized records and one partial-profile scenario illustrate the calculations. The fuzzy results retain all reference classifications. Two of the four complete records are referred for review; including the additional scenario gives three referrals among five cases. The referral set is unchanged at half-widths of 5, 7, and 10. After one training pass, the perceptron misclassifies the partial-profile scenario even when the assumed missing score is supplied. The weighted calculation gives the reference status using either the available scores or the assumed complete profile. These results document the referral procedure and the limits of the neural prototype. The design keeps its estimate separate from the official status and leaves borderline decisions to a reviewer. Predictive performance and the consistency of human review require evaluation on larger datasets.

title: 河北省太行山革命老区公共体育服务高质量发展现状、问题与策略
abstractText: 河北省太行山革命老区是我国重要的红色文化发源之地，其常住居民公共服务水平理应备受关注。但由于当前河北省经济发展不平衡及革命老区地域跨度大等特性，导致当地公共体育服务现状与居民需求水平存在差距。因此本研究基于我国“第十五个五年规划纲要”中“加快建设体育强国”规划方针与国务院印发《体育强国纲要》等文件内容为依据，使用问卷调查、深度访谈、数据分析与文献资料研究等方法，对涉县、武安市、易县、涞源县、平山县等河北省太行山革命老区的公共体育服务现状展开调查。发现当地公共体育服务建设存在人口老龄化导致代际认知断层、经济不平衡导致服务供给存在差异、硬件普及与运维滞后之间的张力影响居民参与意愿的问题。针对以上现实瓶颈本文认为应从以居民需求为本优化基层服务内容、利用红色文化资源促进财政收入、拓展体育便民服务增强居民参与活力等方式推动河北省太行山革命老区公共体育服务整体水平提升。

Beyond thrombocytopenia: clinical predictors of PCR-confirmed Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever in Thi-Qar, Iraq (2023–2024)
abstractText: Abstract Background Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever (CCHF) is a major public health challenge in endemic areas with a wide spectrum of clinical manifestations that may overlap with other acute febrile illnesses. Identifying clinical predictors associated with laboratory-confirmed infection may support the early assessment and prioritisation of suspected cases. Objective To identify independent clinical predictors of PCR-confirmed CCHF among suspected cases reported in Thi-Qar governorate, southern Iraq, and to evaluate a simple clinical score based on these predictors. Methods A retrospective, surveillance-based study was conducted using records of suspected CCHF cases from January 2023 to December 2024. We used PCR results to classify cases as confirmed or non-confirmed. We used univariate and multivariable logistic regression to assess factors independently associated with PCR-confirmed infection. A three-point score based on fever, thrombocytopenia, and injection site bleeding was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic analysis and screening performance measures. Results Of 806 suspected patients, 190 tested PCR-positive. In the multivariable analysis, fever (AOR = 13.70, 95% CI: 3.25–58.82, P < 0.001), thrombocytopenia (AOR = 9.26, 95% CI: 3.61–23.81, P < 0.001), injection-site bleeding (AOR = 1.85, 95% CI: 1.05–3.25, P = 0.002), urban residence (AOR = 1.906, 95% CI:1.272–2.857, p = 0.002), and epidemiological exposure (AOR = 8.13, 95% CI: 5.15–12.66, p < 0.001) were independently associated with PCR-confirmed CCHF. By comparison, subcutaneous bleeding did not remain statistically significant after adjustment for other variables. A three-point clinical score, assigning 1 point each for fever, thrombocytopenia, and injection-site bleeding, showed a significant increase in PCR positivity ( p < 0.001) with increasing score from 0% at score 0 to 41.5% at score 3. The score showed modest discriminatory performance (AUC = 0.643, 95% CI: 0.601–0.684, p < 0.001); at a cut-off of ≥ 2, sensitivity was 98.4%, specificity was 24.2%, and negative predictive value was 98.0%. Conclusion Fever, thrombocytopenia and injection-site bleeding were independently associated with PCR-confirmed CCHF among suspected cases in Thi-Qar, Iraq. The proposed three-point score may support early screening and prioritisation when considered alongside epidemiological exposure. However, its modest discrimination and low specificity suggest the score is exploratory and requires further internal and external validation before routine clinical use.

title: Poor ocean conditions reduce chick provisioning in a threatened seabird
abstractText: Abstract Determining variation in behavioral traits is critical for predicting how animals cope with anthropogenic climate change, including those that buffer reproductive output against changing environmental conditions. We investigated how contrasting ocean conditions influenced parental care in the Marbled Murrelet (Brachyramphus marmoratus), a secretive seabird that nests in coastal coniferous forests along the northeastern Pacific Ocean. Using >12,000 hr of video recordings, we quantified chick provisioning at 18 nests that represented 1,332 feeding events across 2 yr of poor (2018, 2019) and 2 yr of more favorable ocean conditions (2021, 2022). Adults provisioned chicks with a single forage fish during nest visits, which occurred primarily during early morning and late evening. Chick diet was consistent across ocean conditions: Pacific sand lance (Ammodytes personatus) and species in the smelt family (Osmeridae) comprised >90% of identified prey, with Pacific herring (Clupea pallasii) and Northern anchovy (Engraulis mordax) also present. Chicks received significantly fewer fish per day during poor ocean conditions (2.0 fish day−1; 95% CI: 1.6, 2.4) relative to more favorable ocean conditions (2.7 fish day−1; 95% CI: 2.4, 3.2). Fewer fish per day were also delivered as nest distance from the coast increased, independent of ocean conditions. However, estimated daily energy intake of chicks was slightly greater during more favorable ocean conditions, likely because Pacific sand lance delivered to chicks during poor ocean conditions were larger and estimated to have a greater energy density. Despite this partial compensation during poor ocean conditions, chicks took 25% longer (8 days) to fledge, increasing their risk of being depredated. Our study indicates that successful murrelet reproduction is dependent on a small number of prey species and that adults did not seek alternative prey to buffer the impacts of poor ocean conditions when rearing offspring. Therefore, climate-driven changes in prey availability are an important limitation on murrelet reproductive output.

A Novel CCMS Model Reveals a Critical Intronic Sequence in the Snrpb Gene that is Required for Normal Development
abstractText: Abstract Pathogenic variants in SNRPB, a common core spliceosomal factor, cause Cerebrocostomandibular Syndrome (CCMS). Most CCMS-associated variants result in increased inclusion of a PTC-containing alternative exon 2 (AE2). Using CRISPR/Cas9 we generated two mutant mice that carried a 46bp or a 61bp deletion upstream of Snrpb AE2. Mice and embryos carrying the 46bp deletion are normal. Whereas heterozygous and homozygous mutant embryos carrying the 61bp deletion (Δ61) exhibited smaller heads, micrognathia, malformations in the bones of the craniofacial region and ribs, and reduced survival, at low penetrance. Embryos homozygous for Δ61 showed a tendency towards increased inclusion of AE2 and reduced levels of Snrpb. In addition, this deletion increased the penetrance and severity of defects in Snrpbncc and Snrpbmes mutant embryos. Our findings indicate that this intronic region is important for SNRPB regulation in mice and should be investigated in CCMS patients that do not carry mutations in SNRPB coding exons.

title: Sequential extraction and characterisation of bioactive gelatin and chitosan from Zophobas morio larvae for sustainable insect biomass valorisation
abstractText: Abstract The growing demand for biopolymers has increased interest in insect biomass as an alternative source of bioactive molecules. This study presents a novel sequential extraction strategy to recover both gelatin and chitosan from larvae of Zophobas morio (edible insect). Gelatin was extracted using acid pretreatment followed by thermal hydrolysis, yielding 8.05 ± 0.2%, with a protein content of 42% and a molecular mass range of approx. 11–74 kDa. Structural characterisation using Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), energy dispersive X-ray analysis (EDAX) and differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) confirmed the preservation of characteristic gelatin functional groups and a fibrillar porous microstructure. Chitosan was subsequently recovered from the residual biomass, exhibiting a chitosan yield of 36.18 ± 1.98% (initial dry biomass basis) and a conversion efficiency of 71.80 ± 3.85% relative to the extracted chitin. Detailed characterisation using FTIR, SEM, EDAX and DSC confirmed its structural integrity, porous fibrous morphology, characteristic elemental composition and suitable thermal stability. The chitosan also exhibited high degree of deacetylation (95.98%) and viscosity-average molecular mass of 458.23 ± 30.59 kDa. Functional evaluation revealed that both insect-derived gelatin and chitosan possessed strong bioactive properties. Gelatin exhibited superior antioxidant activity (IC 50 = 0.34 mg/ml) compared to commercial porcine gelatin. Chitosan demonstrated notable antioxidant activity (IC 5 0 = 4.90 mg/ml) and antimicrobial activity against Gram-positive, Gram-negative bacteria and the fungus Candida albicans . Overall, this study demonstrates the potential of Z. morio larvae as a source of biologically active gelatin and chitosan.

Prehospital Pediatric Ventilation Quality Following Use of a Feedback Device: A Randomized Study
abstractText: OBJECTIVE Manual ventilation is a lifesaving intervention for children in respiratory arrest, yet the quality of pediatric ventilation delivered by emergency medical services (EMS) clinicians across geographically distinct sites is poorly characterized. We evaluated baseline EMS ventilation performance and whether a ventilation feedback device (VFD) improves adherence to national and international ventilation guidelines for ventilation rate, tidal volume, and mask seal. METHODS We conducted a single-anonymized, randomized, crossover study of EMS clinicians from 5 EMS agencies across 3 metropolitan sites in the United States. Using a simulated 3-year-old toddler manikin, participants completed 2 sequential 2-minute respiratory arrest scenarios separated by a 10-minute washout period. Participants performed ventilation with and without real-time VFD feedback in randomized order. The EOLifeX VFD recorded ventilation rate, tidal volume, and mask leak with each breath. Adherence to age-based guidelines was analyzed using generalized linear mixed-effects models with participants nested within sites. RESULTS We enrolled 123 participants across 5 agencies. With VFD feedback, guideline-recommended tidal volumes were achieved in 87% of breaths compared with 16.2% without feedback. Ventilation rate adherence improved from 65% to 88.6%. Mask leak of less than 30% occurred in 88.4% of ventilations with feedback vs 80% without feedback. CONCLUSION In our simulation study, EMS clinicians rarely met manual ventilation guidelines for pediatric patients in respiratory arrest. The use of a VFD substantially improved guideline adherence, suggesting broad potential to improve ventilation performance.

title: Effects of surgery, radiotherapy or surveillance on the objective vestibular function, vestibular symptoms and quality of life in vestibular schwannoma patients
abstractText: Abstract Objective To evaluate the effect of active surveillance, radiotherapy and surgery on the vestibular function, vestibular symptoms, and quality of life in unilateral vestibular schwannoma (VS) patients. Methods In this prospective longitudinal study at a tertiary referral center, patients underwent caloric and video head impulse (vHIT) testing and completed the Dizziness Handicap Inventory (DHI) and Penn Acoustic Neuroma Quality of Life (PANQOL) questionnaires before and after treatment, with treatment-specific follow-up: at 6, 12 and 24 months after surveillance start, at 6 weeks, 6 and 12 months after radiotherapy, and 1, 3, and 12 months after surgery. Longitudinal changes were analyzed using repeated-measures ANOVA. Results Compared with baseline, the percentage of abnormal caloric tests remained stable in the active surveillance (57%) and surgery groups (93%), but increased significantly in the radiotherapy group (from 77% to 92%; p = 0.02) at 12 months after intervention. All surgical patients showed abnormal vHIT gains one month after surgery, whereas abnormalities gradually increased in the active surveillance (33%) and radiotherapy (85%) groups. Vestibular symptoms remained stable during active surveillance, increased after radiotherapy, and decreased after surgery. At 12 months, DHI and PANQOL scores no longer differed significantly or clinically between groups. Conclusion Active surveillance was associated with the most stable objective and subjective vestibular function. Surgery caused immediate vestibular deterioration, whereas radiotherapy had a delayed comparable effect on mid- to long-term vestibular function. Despite baseline differences, vestibular symptoms and quality of life did not differ significantly between groups 12 months after treatment or initiation of surveillance. Level of Evidence Level II.

title: Economic evaluation of the Be-Prox anti-bullying intervention in Norwegian early childhood education and care settings: an exploratory partial within-trial cost-effectiveness analysis alongside a cluster randomised controlled trial
abstractText: Abstract Background Experience of bullying during childhood incurs significant societal costs. While school-based anti-bullying programs have shown cost-effectiveness, there is a lack of economic evaluations of interventions aimed at reducing peer victimization at the preschool level. While the Be‑Prox intervention showed no effect on its primary outcome, reductions were observed in monthly victimization rates, motivating an economic evaluation of its potential value. Methods An exploratory partial within-trial cost-effectiveness analysis was conducted alongside a cluster randomized controlled trial (RCT) of the Be-Prox intervention in Norwegian early childhood education and care (ECEC) settings, from a provider and partial municipality perspective. The trial included 38 ECECs (19 intervention, 19 control) and 708 children aged 3–5 years. Costs were collected bottom-up through interviews and surveys, and control group costs were assumed to be zero. The incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) was calculated using the unweighted mean difference in ECEC-level proportions of children spared from negative acts between arms at follow-up. Uncertainty was assessed using ECEC level bootstrap resampling, summarized through cost-effectiveness planes and acceptability curves. Deterministic sensitivity analyses varied intervention costs by ± 1 SD, ± 1 standard error of the mean, and assignment of 10–30% of intervention costs to the control group. Results Total intervention costs were 1,889,031 Norwegian kroner (NOK) (165,270 EUR) across 19 ECECs. The primary ICER was 41,336 NOK (3,616 EUR) per child saved, based on a mean difference of 12.9% points between arms, corresponding to 45.7 children saved. A secondary, explorative ICER based on an adjusted odds ratio (0.40) from the effect paper was 26,330 NOK (2,304 EUR) per child saved, corresponding to 71.7 children saved. The primary ICER remained within a similar order of magnitude when intervention costs were varied by ± 1 SD (16,734 − 65,936 NOK; 1,464-5,770 EUR), was narrower under ± 1 SEM (35,691 − 46,980 NOK; 3,123-4,110 EUR), and reduced when control-group costs were assigned 10–30% of intervention costs (28,931–37,206 NOK; 2,531–3,255 EUR) under nonzero assumption. The probabilistic sensitivity analysis showed 97.3% of bootstrap draws in the north-east quadrant of the CE-plane, with the CEAC indicating 50% probability of cost-effectiveness at the primary ICER threshold, rising to 88% at 100,000 NOK (8,749 EUR) per child saved. Conclusions The Be-Prox intervention has the potential to be cost-effective. While exploratory, these findings provide the first economic evidence for bullying prevention at ECEC level and may inform early preventive strategies. Future research should adopt broader societal perspectives and longer follow-up to capture downstream cost savings. Trial registration The project is registered at ClinicalTrials with ID number NCT06040437, at 02.09.2023.

title: Meningkatkan Minat Berkunjung Ulang Konsumen Kedai Food truck di Gor Lembu Peteng Kabupaten Tulungagung Menggunakan Kualitas Produk Dengan Kepuasan Sebagai Variabel Intervening
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh kualitas produk terhadap minat berkunjung ulang; pengaruh kualitas produk terhadap kepuasan; dan pengaruh kepuasan terhadap minat berkunjung ulang. Penelitian ini disusun berdasarkan fakta bahwa minat berkunjung ulang konsumen masih rendah; meskipun kedai food truck Gor Lembu Peteng yang memiliki keunikan cara menjual tersendiri pada masing-masing kedainya. Metode penelitian ini mengunakan metode penelitian kuantitatif dengan populasi pelanggan setia yang berkunjung ulang. Teknik pengambilan sampel menggunakan random sampling sejumlah 200 pelanggan. Variabel terdiri dari kualitas produk (X1), kepuasan (X2), dan minat berkunjung ulang (X3). Pengumpulan data menggunakan dokumen dan angket. Teknik analisis data yang digunakan adalah analisis faktorial The Structural Equation Modelling (SEM). Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa: kualitas produk pengaruh positif signifikan terhadap minat berkunjung ulang menunjukkan nilai probabilitas sebesar 0,008 dibawah nilai p value 0,050; kualitas produk tidak berpengaruh positif signifikan terhadap kepuasan menunjukkan nilai probabilitas sebesar 0,587 diatas nilai p value 0,050; kepuasan berpengaruh positif signifikan terhadap minat berkunjung ulang menunjukkan nilai probabilitas sebesar 0,006 dibawah nilai p value 0,050. Penelitian ini penting untuk memberikan konstribusi Ilmu Pendidikan Kewirausahaan dengan penelitian yang sejenis terkait minat berkunjung ulang, kualitas produk dan kepuasan.

Broadband Optical Characterization of Tetragonal Barium Titanate by Mueller-Matrix Spectroscopic Ellipsometry
abstractText: Abstract Barium titanate (BTO), one of the earliest reported ferroelectric materials, exhibits strong second-order nonlinearity and an ultrafast Pockels effect, making it highly attractive for photonics. However, its optical constants remain uncertain largely due to the ubiquitous ferroelectric–ferroelastic multidomain microstructure, which depolarizes and averages out the anisotropic optical response, thereby complicating conventional ellipsometric approaches. Here, we report a Kramers–Kronig-consistent complex refractive-index tensor of tetragonal BTO from the ultraviolet (190 nm) to the far-infrared (40 μm) derived from multimodal Mueller-matrix spectroscopic ellipsometry. We further quantify optical loss by incorporating transmission intensity measured over the 2–10 μm transparency window, resolving the extinction coefficient down to ∼10–5. To verify the underlying domain configuration, we performed independent structural analyses, including electron backscatter diffraction, confocal Raman microscopy, and Kelvin probe force microscopy. We then reconstruct an effective optical model for our multidomain BTO sample, formulated as a mixture of three tetragonal variants with the determined intrinsic refractive indices, to link microscopic domains to the macroscopic optical response. Our work presents a unified, experimentally cross-validated data set, enabling accurate modeling for electro-optic modulators and high-Q nanophotonic resonators without ad hoc approximations, and provides a general strategy for optical metrology of complex ferroic crystals.

title: Liquid biopsy identifies tumor-derived mir-302/367 cluster as a macrophage-reprogramming axis sustaining immune cold prostate cancer
abstractText: Abstract Background Despite extensive clinical investigation, immunotherapy has failed to demonstrate consistent clinical benefit in prostate cancer (PCa), largely due to the development of an immunologically cold tumor microenvironment that resists immunotherapeutic strategies. However, the mechanisms through which systemic signals precondition tumor-associated macrophages to shape immune suppression remain poorly understood. Methods To address this, peripheral blood immune cells patients undergoing diagnostic workup for suspected PCa were analyzed, and plasma-derived extracellular vesicles were isolated from liquid biopsy samples for functional studies. Peripheral blood monocytes were isolated and differentiated ex vivo into macrophages. Results Patients with PCa harbour macrophages skewed away from pro-inflammatory M1-like features toward an M2-like immunoregulatory state, and this shift correlated with histological grade. The collapse of inflammatory cytokine production and antigen-presenting traits was accompanied by high levels of the miR-302/367 cluster in ex vivo differentiated patient-derived macrophages. Inhibition of miR-302a-5p and miR-367-3p restored M1-like phenotype across all grades, while sparing macrophages from biopsy-negative controls. Moreover, PCa cells released extracellular vesicles enriched in these microRNAs imprinting an M2-like programme onto monocyte-derived macrophages, whereas microRNA-depleted vesicles promoted M1-like polarization. Plasma-derived vesicles from PCa patients recapitulated this scenario, supporting the possible clinical relevance of this axis. Conclusions Collectively, these data identify a tumor-derived EV-miR-302/367 axis associated with macrophage reprogramming in PCa and support its role as a functional regulator of systemic myeloid conditioning.

title: CYP1B1 is a potential target of kaempferol in renal fibrosis: a multi‑omics and single‑cell transcriptomics study
abstractText: Abstract Background Renal fibrosis (RF) is a progressive and irreversible pathological process for which effective treatments are limited. This study explores the molecular targets and mechanisms through which kaempferol (Kae) ameliorates RF, with particular emphasis on cytochrome P450 1B1 (CYP1B1). Methods Using a combination of transcriptomic profiling, weighted gene co‑expression network analysis (WGCNA), multi‑algorithm machine learning [least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO), support vector machine‑recursive feature elimination (SVM‑RFE), and Random Forest], and single‑cell transcriptomics, we identified the core targets of Kae intervention in RF. shapley additive explanations (SHAP) analysis evaluated gene contributions to the predictive model, while cell‑type identification by estimating relative subsets of RNA transcripts (CIBERSORT) estimated the immune microenvironment. The cell type-specific distribution of core targets was further characterized through single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), and the scTenifoldKnk (a machine learning-based virtual gene knockout tool) algorithm simulated the effects of CYP1B1 loss-of-function on fibroblast activation and extracellular matrix (ECM) deposition. Finally, molecular docking was performed to predict the binding conformations of kaempferol with the proteins encoded by the six prioritized genes. Results Six core genes (VCAM1, NFKBIA, SFN, CCL5, CYP1B1, and AXL) were identified from 25 Kae-RF-related genes, with CYP1B1 as an upstream regulatory hub. Immune infiltration analysis revealed increased plasma cells and eosinophils, alongside decreased M0/M1 macrophages and activated NK cells. Single-cell analysis localized CYP1B1 to smooth muscle cells and fibroblasts, with significant upregulation during late-stage fibroblast-to-myofibroblast differentiation. Virtual knockdown of CYP1B1 upregulated 46 genes associated with fibrosis-related biological processes, including cell adhesion, G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) signaling, ion transport, and cytoskeletal remodeling. The six-gene diagnostic model achieved area under the curves (AUCs) of 0.889 (training) and 0.759 (external validation). Molecular docking showed favorable Kae–CYP1B1 binding (− 6.5 kcal/mol). Conclusion CYP1B1 may serve as a potential functional target of Kae in RF, likely through modulation of fibroblast activation and ECM remodeling. These findings are hypothesis‑generating and provide a computational basis for future experimental validation of CYP1B1‑targeted strategies in RF.

title: PENDAMPINGAN PEMANFAATAN WEBSITE SEBAGAI MEDIA INFORMASI DAN TRANSPARANSI PUBLIK PADA PANTI ASUHAN AMANAH
abstractText: Perkembangan teknologi digital mendorong lembaga sosial untuk meningkatkan akses informasi dan transparansi kepada masyarakat. Panti Asuhan Amanah sebelumnya masih mengelola informasi secara konvensional sehingga penyampaian informasi kegiatan, profil lembaga, dan layanan donasi belum dapat dilakukan secara optimal. Pendampingan juga meningkatkan kemampuan pengurus dalam mengelola konten website secara mandiri. Dengan demikian, kegiatan ini berkontribusi dalam memperluas akses informasi, meningkatkan transparansi kegiatan, dan mendukung pengelolaan komunikasi digital panti secara berkelanjutan.

PENGARUH SUPERVISI AKADEMIK TERHADAP KOMPETENSI PROFESIONAL GURU DI MADRASAH IBTIDAIYAH
abstractText: ABSTRACT Teachers’ professional competence is a crucial element in the implementation of learning in the digital era, as teachers are required to develop pedagogical capabilities, utilize technology, and adapt instructional practices to students’ needs. One form of support that can facilitate teachers’ professional development is academic supervision; however, its effectiveness needs to be empirically examined within the context of educational institutions. This study aimed to analyze the effect of academic supervision on teachers’ professional competence at Madrasah Ibtidaiyah Negeri 3 Sukoharjo. The study employed a quantitative approach using a survey method and involved 27 civil servant teachers as respondents through total sampling. Data were collected using a closed-ended questionnaire and analyzed through prerequisite tests and simple linear regression. The results showed a regression coefficient of 0.173, with a t-value of 1.644 and a significance value of 0.113 > 0.05, indicating that academic supervision was not statistically significant in predicting teachers’ professional competence. The R Square value of 0.098 indicated that the research model explained 9.8% of the variance in teachers’ professional competence, while the remaining 90.2% was not explained by the variables included in the model. Therefore, academic supervision remains relevant as part of professional development, but the development of teachers’ competence needs to be addressed through a more comprehensive and sustainable professional development framework. ABSTRAK Kompetensi profesional guru merupakan salah satu unsur penting dalam penyelenggaraan pembelajaran di era digital karena guru dituntut mampu mengembangkan kemampuan pedagogis, memanfaatkan teknologi, dan menyesuaikan praktik pembelajaran dengan kebutuhan peserta didik. Salah satu bentuk pembinaan yang dapat digunakan untuk mendukung pengembangan profesional guru adalah supervisi akademik, tetapi efektivitasnya perlu dibuktikan melalui pengujian empiris sesuai dengan konteks lembaga pendidikan. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis pengaruh supervisi akademik terhadap kompetensi profesional guru di Madrasah Ibtidaiyah Negeri 3 Sukoharjo. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan metode survey dan melibatkan 27 guru ASN sebagai responden melalui teknik total sampling. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan kuesioner tertutup dan dianalisis melalui uji prasyarat serta regresi linear sederhana. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan koefisien regresi sebesar 0,173 dengan nilai t sebesar 1,644 dan signifikansi 0,113 > 0,05, sehingga supervisi akademik belum terbukti berpengaruh secara signifikan terhadap kompetensi profesional guru. Nilai R Square sebesar 0,098 menunjukkan bahwa model penelitian menjelaskan 9,8% variasi kompetensi profesional guru, sedangkan 90,2% variasi lainnya belum dijelaskan oleh model. Dengan demikian, supervisi akademik tetap relevan sebagai bagian dari pembinaan profesional, tetapi pengembangan kompetensi guru perlu ditempatkan dalam kerangka pengembangan profesional yang lebih komprehensif dan berkelanjutan.

title: Analisis Pengaruh Kecemasan Matematika dan Motivasi Belajar terhadap Prestasi Belajar Matematika Siswa pada Materi Aljabar
abstractText: Aim: This study aimed to examine whether mathematics anxiety and learning motivation statistically predict algebra achievement, both individually and jointly, among Year 7 students at an integrated Islamic junior secondary school in Indonesia. Method: A quantitative ex post facto correlational design was employed, involving 64 Year 7 students from SMPIT Ar-Risalah Sukoharjo. Mathematics anxiety and learning motivation were measured using two separate 30-item questionnaires, while algebra achievement was assessed through an algebra test. Data were analysed using multiple linear regression following diagnostic assessments of residual normality, linearity, multicollinearity, and heteroscedasticity, with statistical significance set at 0.05. Results: Mathematics anxiety did not significantly predict algebra achievement (B = 0.046, ? = 0.152, p = 0.357). Similarly, learning motivation was not a statistically significant predictor (B = 0.063, ? = 0.227, p = 0.171). The overall regression model was not statistically significant, F(2, 61) = 0.961, p = 0.388, R² = 0.031. Achievement scores were concentrated within a narrow, high-performing range (82–95; M = 90.08, SD = 2.97). Novelty/Implication: This study provides context-specific empirical evidence regarding the limited predictive contribution of two affective factors to early secondary algebra achievement when observed performance exhibits restricted variability. The non-significant findings do not imply that mathematics anxiety and learning motivation are educationally irrelevant; instead, they highlight the importance of considering score distributions and measurement characteristics when interpreting predictive relationships. The findings underscore the need to integrate affective, cognitive, and instructional indicators into comprehensive models of mathematics achievement and to employ assessment instruments capable of capturing meaningful differences in students' mathematical performance.
