title: Prototipe IoT Memantau Kebisingan Area Kantor PT X pada 36,91–59,90 dBA
abstractText: Mengembangkan dan mengevaluasi prototipe pemantauan kebisingan berbasis Internet of Things (IoT) di area perkantoran PT X serta mendeskripsikan fungsi awalnya berdasarkan pengukuran pada beberapa lokasi kerja. Penelitian ini menilai kemampuan pemantauan, bukan menetapkan nilai ambang paparan kerja yang baru. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan deskriptif kuantitatif melalui pengembangan prototipe dengan sensor suara MAX4466 dan mikrokontroler ESP32. Data diperoleh dari pengukuran pada 11 titik ruangan yang tercatat selama 30 Juni sampai 2 Juli 2026. Nilai hasil pembacaan disajikan menurut ruangan dan dibandingkan secara deskriptif dengan nilai acuan yang tercantum pada tabel penelitian. Kalibrasi independen dan analisis ketidakpastian pengukuran belum dilaporkan. Nilai terendah sebesar 36,91 dBA ditemukan di Ruang Pelaksana Pengadaan, sedangkan nilai tertinggi sebesar 59,90 dBA tercatat di Ruang Hukum Korporat. Seluruh hasil pembacaan berada di bawah nilai pembanding masing-masing ruangan yang berkisar 55–75 dBA. Prototipe mampu menampilkan perbedaan tingkat suara secara langsung. Namun, data tersebut belum membuktikan akurasi sensor, keterulangan hasil, ataupun tingkat paparan kebisingan kerja selama satu periode kerja. Prototipe dapat digunakan sebagai sarana awal untuk menampilkan dan mencatat kondisi tingkat suara pada lokasi pengamatan. Penerapan untuk keputusan keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja masih memerlukan kalibrasi dengan alat ukur tersertifikasi, pengujian berulang pada kondisi berbeda, penilaian kestabilan data, dan evaluasi paparan sesuai durasi pengukuran.

title: Morphological Neuronal-Like Differentiation of Human Dental Pulp Stem Cells Induced By ROCK Inhibitor
abstractText: Neuronal regeneration remains a major challenge in the treatment of neurological disorders because of the limited regenerative capacity of neurons. Human dental pulp stem cells (hDPSCs) represent a promising cell source for neural regeneration because of their neurogenic differentiation potential. Rho-associated kinase (ROCK), a key regulator of cytoskeletal dynamics, influences neuronal morphogenesis. However, the morphological and functional consequences of ROCK, Y-27632 inhibition in hDPSCs remain incompletely characterized. This study investigated the neurogenic effects of ROCK inhibition in hDPSCs. Cells were characterized for mesenchymal stem cell properties and treated with 30 μM Y-27632. Neuronal differentiation was evaluated by Cresyl violet staining, scanning electron microscopy, βIII-tubulin immunofluorescence, and intracellular Ca²⁺ imaging. Y-27632 treatment induced pronounced morphological remodeling, resulting in distinct bipolar and multipolar neuron-like phenotypes accompanied by βIII-tubulin expression. Importantly, Y-27632-treated cells exhibited a rapid increase in intracellular Ca²⁺ fluorescence following KCl stimulation, supporting the acquisition of depolarization-responsive properties. These findings demonstrate that ROCK inhibition promotes morphological and functional neuronal-like differentiation of hDPSCs, supporting their potential utility in neural regeneration research.

title: EDUKASI ANTI-BULLYING OLEH MAHASISWA KKN UNTIDAR DALAM MENINGKATKAN PEMAHAMAN SISWA SDN 1 SONOREJO, CANDIMULYO, MAGELANG
abstractText: Perundungan di lingkungan sekolah dasar menjadi persoalan yang memerlukan perhatian serius karena berdampak pada kesehatan mental, kesejahteraan sosial, dan prestasi akademik siswa. Kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan pemahaman siswa kelas II SDN 1 Sonorejo, Kecamatan Candimulyo, Kabupaten Magelang, mengenai bentuk, dampak, dan pencegahan bullying melalui pendekatan edukatif-interaktif. Metode yang digunakan meliputi penyampaian materi, diskusi, simulasi, serta evaluasi menggunakan pre-test dan post-test terhadap 35 siswa. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan adanya peningkatan rata-rata skor pemahaman dari 43,4 pada pre-test menjadi 84,0 pada post-test atau meningkat sebesar 40,6 poin. Peningkatan tertinggi terjadi pada indikator pengucilan sosial dan cara melapor kepada guru. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa pendekatan edukatif-interaktif efektif dalam memperluas literasi sosial dan kesadaran empati siswa sekolah dasar. Program ini berkontribusi sebagai langkah preventif dalam mendukung terciptanya iklim sekolah yang aman dan inklusif

title: Lean Service Transformation Using Value Stream Mapping to Improve Time Efficiency and Reduce Operational Waste in Automotive Service Workshops
abstractText: This study aims to improve routine vehicle service efficiency at PT Sun Star Prima Motor Siliwangi using Value Stream Mapping (VSM) within a Lean Service framework. A case study approach was employed using observation, interviews, and company data. VSM was applied to map the current state, classify activities into Value Added (VA), Non Value Added (NVA), and Necessary but Non Value Added (NNVA), and identify waste and bottlenecks. A Future State Map was developed to streamline workflows and eliminate waste. Results show that total processing time decreased from 184.27 to 140.79 minutes, demonstrating that Lean Service and VSM can reduce lead time, improve operational efficiency, and enhance customer satisfaction in automotive service operations.

title: INKUBASI BISNIS BERBASIS ZERO WASTE STRATEGI EKONOMI HIJAU PADA KOMUNITAS ANAK TERLANTAR SEMARANG
abstractText: Komunitas anak terlantar di Al-Idris Kota Semarang menghadapi tantangan struktural berupa keterbatasan akses pendidikan formal dan ketiadaan keterampilan praktis untuk kemandirian ekonomi. Fenomena ini berisiko memperpanjang siklus kemiskinan pada kelompok rentan. Pendekatan ini mengintegrasikan teknik pewarnaan alami dengan penguatan nilai kearifan lokal sebagai identitas produk unik. Melalui metode pendampingan komprehensif mulai dari pelatihan teknis produksi hingga manajemen pemasaran digital program ini membekali mereka dengan life skills bernilai jual tinggi di green market. Program ini juga merespons kebijakan strategis mengenai 8 Industri Strategis, terutama dalam pengembangan Sektor Industri Kreatif dan Pengolahan berbasis sumber daya lokal yang ramah lingkungan. Di tengah meningkatnya tren pasar green product, inisiatif ini hadir untuk menjembatani potensi pasar dengan pemberdayaan kelompok marginal. Secara global, langkah ini merupakan manifestasi nyata dari pencapaian SDGs, terutama dalam upaya penghapusan kemiskinan dan penyediaan akses pendidikan bagi semua lapisan masyarakat.

abstractText: Infeksi virus dengue (DENV) merupakan arbovirosis dengan laju penyebaran tercepat di dunia dan beban yang terus meningkat di Indonesia. Tahun 2024 tercatat sebagai tahun dengan jumlah kasus tertinggi yang pernah dilaporkan kepada Badan Kesehatan Dunia (WHO), dan Indonesia menempati posisi kedua terbesar di dunia. Dalam dua tahun terakhir, lanskap tata laksana dan pencegahan dengue berubah secara substansial: WHO menerbitkan pedoman klinis berbasis GRADE untuk penyakit arboviral pada Juli 2025, vaksin tetravalen TAK-003 memperoleh rekomendasi WHO dan data efektivitas dunia nyata pertamanya, vaksin dosis tunggal Butantan-DV melaporkan hasil fase 3, sementara kandidat antivirus spesifik pertama memasuki dan sebagian dihentikan pada uji klinis fase 2. Tinjauan pustaka ini merangkum bukti terkini mengenai epidemiologi, patogenesis, diagnosis, pencegahan, dan penatalaksanaan infeksi dengue dengan penekanan pada pasien dewasa serta konteks endemis Indonesia. Diagnosis awal berfokus pada pemilihan pemeriksaan yang sesuai dengan hari sakit; meta-analisis terbaru menunjukkan sensitivitas enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) antigen nonstruktural 1 (NS1) sebanding dengan reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) pada fase awal. Pencegahan bergeser dari pengendalian vektor berbasis insektisida, yang efektivitasnya menurun karena terjadinya resistensi, menuju pendekatan biologis Wolbachia dan vaksinasi. Penatalaksanaan tetap bersifat suportif dengan terapi utama yaitu resusitasi cairan kristaloid; WHO 2025 secara eksplisit menyarankan tidak menggunakan kortikosteroid sistemik maupun transfusi trombosit profilaksis, dan merekomendasikan kadar laktat serta waktu pengisian kapiler sebagai pemandu terapi cairan. Keterbatasan saat ini adalah ketiadaan terapi antivirus spesifik, keterbatasan data efikasi vaksin terhadap serotipe DENV-3 dan DENV-4 pada individu seronegatif, serta minimnya uji acak terkendali pada populasi dewasa.

TINGKAT KESIAPAN MASYARAKAT DALAM PERENCANAAN PEMBANGUNAN DESA (STUDI KASUS DI DESA JAMBEARJO, KECAMATAN TAJINAN, KABUPATEN MALANG)
abstractText: Desentralisasi telah menjadi asas utama dalam penyelenggaraan pemerintahan di Indonesia, sebagaimana diatur dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2014 tentang Pemerintahan Daerah. Lebih lanjut, Undang-Undang Nomor 6 Tahun 2014 tentang Desa memberikan kewenangan bagi desa untuk bertransformasi menjadi komunitas mandiri yang mampu mengelola proses pembangunannya sendiri, mulai dari perencanaan, implementasi, hingga evaluasi. Keberhasilan pembangunan desa sangat bergantung pada partisipasi aktif masyarakat, yang sangat dipengaruhi oleh tingkat kesiapan masyarakat itu sendiri. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis tingkat kesiapan masyarakat dalam perencanaan pembangunan desa di Desa Jambearjo, Kecamatan Tajinan, Kabupaten Malang, yang merupakan salah satu desa percontohan implementasi Undang-Undang Desa. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan deskriptif kuantitatif dengan metode Community Readiness Model (CRM) . Data dikumpulkan dari 371 responden masyarakat melalui kuesioner terstruktur yang mencakup enam dimensi kesiapan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa skor rata-rata kesiapan masyarakat Desa Jambearjo adalah 10,73, yang menempatkan komunitas tersebut pada tahap Inisiasi (Tahap 6). Tahap ini mengindikasikan bahwa informasi yang tersedia sudah cukup untuk menjustifikasi keputusan dan kegiatan terkait perencanaan pembangunan. Analisis per dimensi mengungkapkan bahwa dimensi "Kepemimpinan" memperoleh skor tertinggi (12,95), mencerminkan dukungan kuat dari tokoh lokal, sementara dimensi "Sumber Daya Terkait Isu" memperoleh skor terendah (7,6), yang menunjukkan ketergantungan tinggi pada pendanaan pemerintah serta keterbatasan tenaga ahli lokal. Untuk meningkat ke tahap selanjutnya, intervensi strategis harus difokuskan pada penyediaan informasi teknis yang spesifik melalui pelatihan internal (in-service training) dan diversifikasi mobilisasi sumber daya lokal.

title: Membangun Resiliensi Mental Remaja melalui Pemberdayaan Literasi Digital Berbasis Nilai-Nilai Islam di Wilayah Cirebon
abstractText: Rendahnya literasi digital dan meningkatnya tekanan psikologis di kalangan remaja akibat penggunaan media sosial yang berlebihan menjadi isu penting yang perlu mendapatkan perhatian edukatif. Program pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan literasi digital sekaligus membangun kesadaran kesehatan mental remaja SMA/sederajat di wilayah Cirebon melalui kegiatan Seminar dan lomba poster bertema “Literasi Digital dan Kesehatan Mental Remaja.” Metode yang digunakan adalah Community Based Research (CBR) dengan empat tahapan utama: identifikasi masalah, perencanaan program, pelaksanaan intervensi, dan evaluasi hasil. Empat kali survei dilakukan, dua survei awal (Mei-Juni 2025) untuk pemetaan masalah dan dua survei berikutnya (pra dan pasca seminar) untuk mengukur efektivitas kegiatan. Analisis data menggunakan pendekatan deskriptif kuantitatif dan uji beda berpasangan (paired t-test). Hasil menunjukkan peningkatan signifikan pada aspek etika digital, keamanan siber, dan kepercayaan diri, serta penurunan tingkat kecemasan digital peserta. Temuan ini membuktikan bahwa intervensi edukatif singkat berbasis komunitas efektif dalam meningkatkan kesadaran etika berinternet dan keseimbangan psikologis remaja. Kegiatan ini berkontribusi dalam membentuk perilaku digital yang sehat serta mendukung pencapaian Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) poin 3 tentang kesehatan dan kesejahteraan serta poin 4 tentang pendidikan berkualitas.

abstractText: The research work Evaluation of the effectiveness of nursing interventions in healthcare-associated infections, internal medicine. The objective of the research was to determine compliance with nursing interventions aimed at preventing healthcare-associated infections in the Internal Medicine service of the Alfredo Noboa Montenegro Hospital, Ecuador. A descriptive study was developed, with a quantitative approach and non-experimental design. The sample consisted of ten nursing professionals, selected through non-probabilistic sampling with inclusion and exclusion criteria. The information was collected through an observation guide and processed in Microsoft Excel. The results showed differences in the application of the measures. Compliance with hand hygiene reached 100% before aseptic procedures and after exposure to body fluids; however, it corresponded to 60% before contact with the patient, 70% after touching him, and 40% after contact with his environment. Disinfection with alcohol gel among patients registered an adherence of 20%. Difficulties in the use of personal protective equipment were identified. In contrast, compliance with the hand washing technique, the use of sterile material, the aseptic technique, the daily evaluation of the urinary catheter, and the maintenance of closed drainage were observed. It was concluded that the observed practices have strengths and gaps that require institutional attention. It was recommended to strengthen continuous training, supervision, and monitoring of biosafety standards, as well as to implement audits and feedback to improve adherence to protocols and consolidate a culture of safety in hospital care.

Living with Wilt: Disease, Control, and Plantation Ecologies in Chinese Banana Farming in Cambodia
abstractText: Drawing on fieldwork conducted in August 2026 at four Chinese-invested banana enterprises in Cambodia and interviews with a biotechnology supplier, this article examines how plant disease is understood, managed, and experienced within plantation production. Managers, technical specialists, and Cambodian workers offered overlapping explanations centred on fungi, bacteria, mixed infections, continuous cultivation, and insects. These accounts reflected differences in occupational responsibilities, training, and exposure to economic risk. Yet causal explanations did not translate straightforwardly into control practices: actors with similar diagnoses adopted different interventions, while those with different explanations converged on the same cultivar or microbial products. Access to capital, professional experience, commercial interests, and perceived limitations in public plant-health support mediated these choices. Cultivar replacement emerged as the principal response, alongside soil amendments, biological products, and chemical treatments. Interview accounts also linked disease and its management to concerns about soil condition, unstable earnings, labour mobility, and changing relations between plantations and villages. The article develops the concept of a “control race” to describe efforts to sustain production through successive cultivar changes and spatial relocation while underlying vulnerabilities remain unresolved. Rather than establishing pathogen identity or treatment efficacy, the study shows how disease management redistributes uncertainty and risk across a plantation social–ecological system.

title: Deep Learning-Powered Spatial Transcriptomics Analysis to Predict Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Response from Pre-Treatment Digital Pathology Slides
abstractText: Response to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) is governed in part by the spatial organization of the tumour microenvironment, yet most deep learning models applied to digital pathology treat tissue regions independently and therefore do not represent the neighbourhood interactions that shape immune activation. This study develops and retrospectively evaluates a Neighborhood-aware Masked Graph Spiking Neural Network (NAMG-SNN) that classifies ICI responders and non-responders from pre-treatment haematoxylin and eosin whole-slide images. Whole-slide images are stain-normalized, tiled and encoded into patch-level embeddings that combine statistical, textural, morphological and deep semantic descriptors. A spatial graph is then constructed over the retained patches and pruned by an adaptive similarity mask that suppresses weak or artefactual neighbourhood edges. The masked graph is propagated through a leaky integrate-and-fire spiking network whose accumulated firing rates form a spatial transcriptomic representation, which is finally classified into responder and non-responder categories. The model was evaluated on an integrated cohort assembled from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), the Panoptic segmentation of nUclei and tissue in Melanoma pathology Challenge (PUMA challenge) and the Phoenix virtual spatial transcriptomics resource, using patient-level splitting. On the integrated test data the framework reached 97.31% accuracy, 96.94% precision, 97.82% recall, 97.38% F1-score and 98.87% area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), with a Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.947 and Cohen’s kappa of 0.946, exceeding convolutional, transformer and graph baselines trained under identical conditions. Transcriptomic reconstruction reached a Pearson correlation of 0.962, mean absolute error of 0.051, root mean square error of 0.081 and structural similarity index (SSIM) of 0.966. Ablation confirmed that neighbourhood-aware graph construction, adaptive masking and spike-based learning each contributed to performance. These results are retrospective and computational.

LPG Gas Leakage Detection and Control System Using ESP32 with Automated Solenoid Valve and Telegram Integration
abstractText: A gas leak is hazardous since it may cause fires, lead to explosions and result in people dying. This is the reason why it is important to have procedures for detecting a gas leak and for stopping it quickly. A smart gas leak system built on the Internet of Things is described in this study. This system is able to detect a gas leak promptly, gives the user an immediate alarm and automatically switches off the gas. It uses an ESP32 microcontroller as its main element. An MQ-2 gas sensor is employed to detect a leak of LPG gas. A relay-controlled solenoid valve is used to stop the gas flow. A buzzer and an I2C LCD display are used to give alarms. A Telegram bot sends messages quickly and enables people to check from a distance. Tests have proved that the system detects gas leaks accurately and reacts swiftly when the gas level goes above the limit. As soon as a gas leak is detected, the system sounds the alarm, closes the valve to stop the further flow of gas and sends a Telegram message. The system offers a real solution for improving gas leak safety by combining instant communication with automatic action. It works well in houses and small factories and can act as a basis for more intelligent gas safety systems in the future.

title: The potential of edible mushrooms to intervene neuroinflammation in neurological diseases by targeting gut microbiota
abstractText: Abstract Neurological disorders not only diminish the quality of life but also pose significant financial burdens on every patient. Presently, neurological disorders present a challenge to societal medical resources. Strategies to relieve and control neurological disorders are urgently required. Increasing studies have reported a close link among the gut microbiota, neuroinflammation, and neurological disorders. Diet plays a crucial role in influencing gut microbiota, suggesting that dietary supplements could be effective in intervening neurological disorders. Therefore, this review summarizes the relationship between neuroinflammation and neurological disorders, and the impact of gut microbiota on the neuroinflammation of neurological disorders is also discussed. Meanwhile, edible mushrooms, known for their multiple health benefits, have gained increasing attention as a valuable food resource. This highlights the pathways through which edible mushrooms modulate gut microbiota to alleviate neurological disorders by reversing dysbiosis and targeting microbial short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) and tryptophan metabolism pathways. These findings provide robust support for developing therapeutic strategies and potential interventions based on the interactions between edible mushrooms and gut microbiota.

From AI-Assisted Performance to Independent Thinking: A Framework for Developing Higher-Order Thinking with Generative AI in Higher Education
abstractText: In an AI-supported task, a student may explain a weak comparison once it has been identified, yet fail to notice a similar problem without a reminder. A decision about further help therefore needs evidence about what the student did without being prompted. We examine such decisions in English-medium university argumentation and evidence evaluation. The framework brings together English-language work on scaffolding, learner-generated reasoning, metacognitive calibration, and cognitive offloading. We distinguish help that supplies a reason from help that initiates a check. Readiness to work without the first does not establish readiness to work without the second. Coding examples and boundary cases make evidence about these functions interpretable, while six conditional propositions connect reconstruction and regulation to adaptation and transfer. A proposed experiment gives every group comparable diagnostic practice but varies whether teachers use its results to adjust assistance. This comparison isolates the value of using the evidence from learning through the diagnostic task itself. We relate the account to four GenAI approaches and illustrate it with a hypothetical sociology lesson. Help may be retained or restored when a new task requires it. The framework and coding rules need validation, particularly beyond the language and disciplinary settings considered here.

title: Synergistic Dimensional and Passivation Engineering via Blade Coating Enables Efficient and Stable Perovskite Solar Cells
abstractText: Abstract Upscaling perovskite solar cells (PSCs) for large-area industrial manufacturing urgently demands efficient and scalable surface passivation strategies. Although blade coating is highly promising for device upscaling, achieving comprehensive surface passivation remains a key challenge due to the abundant defects inherent in blade-coated perovskite films. Herein, we present a synergistic surface modification strategy combining dimensional engineering with passivation engineering for blade-coated PSCs. We introduce a multifunctional group Lewis base passivator, 5-bromobenzo[b]thiophen-3(2H)-one (BTO), to complement traditional dimensional engineering (e.g., phenethylammonium iodide (PEAI)), which typically struggles to passivate deep-level defects. In this dual strategy, PEAI constructs a robust 2D/3D heterojunction for interfacial energy level alignment, while BTO passivates uncoordinated Pb2+ defects via synergistic dual-site coordination. Consequently, blade-coated PSCs exhibit a power conversion efficiency of 25.15% and maintain 92.7% of their initial efficiency after 1500 h of air exposure (25 °C, 20–30% RH). Furthermore, this strategy mitigates efficiency roll-off upon scaling, yielding a high PCE of 22.02% for 14.7 cm2 minimodules.

title: Quantitative relationship between coupled structural dynamics and collective order in the original Vicsek model
abstractText: Abstract While the Vicsek model is widely used to understand active systems, the explicit relationship between structural evolution and the order transition remains an open question. Here we investigate this relationship in the original Vicsek system. We uncover a structure–order relationship across the investigated densities and noise strengths at fixed velocity and particle number, in which the polar order parameter exhibits a general correlation with the average interaction number. Furthermore, we reveal underlying structural self–similarities: cluster–level and system–level interaction number distributions show consistent normalized profiles, alongside a correlation between cluster size and orientation. Building on these correlations, we develop a phenomenological framework that quantitatively relates the order parameter to structural statistics. Moreover, over the investigated range of velocities, the structural features are maintained, whereas the structural–order correlation is augmented by a velocity factor. This work provides a structural perspective on the Vicsek model and suggests a quantitative relationship between microscopic structural organization and macroscopic collective behavior.

title: Analisis Peran Brand Image dalam Membangun Loyalitas Pelanggan pada Salon Tiara di Kota Makassar
abstractText: This study aims to describe and analyze the influence of Brand Image on customer loyalty at Tiara Salon in Makassar City. This study uses a descriptive qualitative approach with a case study design. Research informants were selected using a purposive sampling technique and consisted of the salon owner, two employees, eight regular customers, and eight new customers. Data collection techniques were conducted through observation, semi-structured interviews, and documentation. Data validity was tested using source triangulation, technical triangulation, and time triangulation. While data analysis was conducted through the stages of data reduction, data presentation, and conclusion drawing. The results show that Tiara Salon's Brand Image is formed through four main aspects: perceived quality, brand associations, brand awareness, and brand trust. Perceptions of quality are built through professional service, satisfactory service results, cleanliness, and punctuality. Brand associations are formed through a family-friendly atmosphere, friendly service, affordable prices, and comprehensive services. Brand awareness develops primarily through word-of-mouth recommendations, even when the salon's social media presence is inactive. Meanwhile, brand trust is built through consistent service quality, honesty, and responsibility in meeting customer needs. These four aspects create a positive experience that encourages customers to return, recommend Salon Tiara to others, and continue to use the salon despite the availability of similar alternatives. Brand Image has a strong influence on forming and maintaining customer loyalty at Salon Tiara in Makassar.

Thermal Degradation in Underground Cable Joints: Techniques, Causes, and Diagnostic Advances – A Review
abstractText: Underground cable (UC) joints are among the most failure-prone components in power distribution networks, particularly under thermal stress. This review explores a range of jointing methods and diagnostic approaches used to assess thermal degradation (TD) in UC joints. The discussion begins with the structural components of high-voltage cables, followed by a comparison of mechanical, electromagnetic, heat-shrink, cold-shrink, and exothermic welding techniques. Each method is evaluated based on materials, performance, application principles, and known limitations. The paper also analyses key contributors to TD, including electrical overloading, improper joint construction, and environmental exposure, with attention to material-level effects such as insulation embrittlement and conductor oxidation. Several diagnostic strategies are assessed, including infrared thermography (IRT), partial discharge (PD) testing, real-time thermal monitoring, and emerging tools like acoustic emission (AE) and AI-driven sensing. A comparative evaluation highlights the trade-offs between sensitivity, practicality, and field performance under various conditions. Accordingly, this review synthesises recent and foundational research to address three questions: (1) What are the dominant causes and pathways of TD in UC joints? (2) How do joint technologies and installation/maintenance practices influence thermal aging risk? (3) Which diagnostic techniques are most effective for detecting TD, and what are their limitations in field deployment? The findings emphasise the importance of integrated monitoring, standardised practices, and appropriate material selection to enhance long-term reliability. Future research should focus on the integration of advanced diagnostic technologies such as AI-driven predictive maintenance systems and real-time thermal monitoring to improve the detection of early-stage TD.

title: A Hybrid Lightweight Convolutional Neural Network Model for Image-Based Robusta Coffee Leaf Diseases Classification
abstractText: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have been widely used for the classification of coffee leaf diseases. However, the resource-intensive nature of conventional CNNs limits their feasibility for coffee leaf disease identification on edge devices in farming scenarios. To achieve a lightweight, high-accuracy CNN model, this paper develops an hybrid MobileNetV2-NASNetMobile for classifying Robusta coffee leaf diseases. The model integrates two lightweight CNNs: MobileNetV2, which employs depthwise separable convolutions for efficiency, and NASNetMobile, which optimizes discriminative feature extraction. Both branches receive input images resized to 224 × 224 pixels. A feature-level integration via concatenation is then used to combine their independent feature representations, thereby enhancing model robustness and generalization. The training and evaluation of the implemented method were conducted using a dataset of 3,678 Robusta coffee leaf images, sourced from publicly available datasets and field photographs. Model performance was assessed using 5-fold cross-validation to obtain a reliable estimate of generalization and to mitigate bias from a single train-test split. The implemented method attained an accuracy of 99.11%, with corresponding precision of 99.05%, recall of 98.97%, and F1-score of 99.00%. Furthermore, expert validation yielded 85% agreement, a discrepancy from the 99.11% test accuracy attributable to curated test conditions versus real-world variability in lighting, symptom severity, and diagnostic subjectivity. These results nonetheless demonstrate the model’s effectiveness as a scalable solution for Robusta coffee leaf disease classification on resource-limited devices.

title: Fatal Cardiopulmonary Collapse, Bilateral Pleural Effusion, and Hypoxic En-cephalopathy in Neglected Severe Preeclampsia: A Case Report on Antenatal Surveillance and Access Gaps
abstractText: Background: Preeclampsia is a leading cause of maternal death worldwide. Where antenatal care (ANC) is absent and women lack health insurance, a hypertensive crisis can progress quickly to fatal multi-organ failure. Objective: To describe the clinical, hemodynamic, and laboratory course of fatal postpartum cardiopulmonary collapse after unmonitored severe preeclampsia. Methods: Single-patient case report (CARE guideline) at Dr. Saiful Anwar General Hospital, Malang, Indonesia. Clinical findings, serial laboratory values, arterial blood gases, echocardiography, ultrasonography, and chest radiography were recorded over nine days of intensive care and presented chronologically, with a descriptive comparison with the literature. Results: A 44-year-old uninsured primiparous woman with no ANC contacts had an emergency cesarean delivery for severe preeclampsia and left a secondary hospital against medical advice on postoperative day 2 because of financial hardship. At tertiary admission she was obtunded (Glasgow Coma Scale 13), with blood pressure 166/94 mmHg, hemoglobin 5.5 g/dL, and oliguria. Radiography showed large asymmetric bilateral pleural effusions (left ~1,250 mL) with compressive atelectasis; PaO₂/FiO₂ was 142.1 mmHg. Echocardiography showed concentric left ventricular hypertrophy, systemic vascular resistance 2,140 dyn·s/cm⁵, and E/e' 17.8 (PCWP ~24 mmHg). Despite mechanical ventilation, nicardipine, transfusions, and albumin, anuric renal failure (creatinine 5.20 mg/dL) and severe acidosis (pH 7.08, lactate 11.4 mmol/L) progressed, and cardiopulmonary arrest occurred on day 9. Conclusion: In this patient, unmonitored severe preeclampsia was followed by fatal cardiopulmonary collapse; hydrostatic overload and endothelial hyperpermeability are proposed mechanisms that were not directly measured. Emergency coverage at private obstetric facilities may help prevent premature discharge.

title: Herpesviruses show consistency in their nuclear egress-associated induction of lamina-depleted areas as measured in an autofluorescent reporter cell model
abstractText: Abstract Human herpesvirus infections span a wide variety of pathogenic outcomes, with individual representatives comprising a huge clinical relevance on human health. Translational research efforts are directed towards the improvement of broadly applicable preventive measures and detailed understanding of viral pathogenesis. Here, we studied rate-limiting steps in viral replication that show high mechanistic conservation among the Herpesviridae family members, in particular concerning the viral nucleocytoplasmic capsid egress. As characterized for several herpesviruses, viral nuclear egress is facilitated by the virus-induced local nuclear lamina rearrangements of infected cells. Hereby, the virus-mediated site-specific phosphorylation at lamin A/C Ser22, followed by cis/trans isomerization of the structural conformation, leads to the induction of lamina-depleted areas (LDAs). We have generated an LDA reporter system in primary human fibroblasts (HFFs), which conditionally express the autofluorescent lamin A/C-RFP fusion construct, for quantifying viral nuclear egress activity. This system was successfully applied for human and animal cytomegaloviruses as well as a selection of α-, β-, and γ-herpesviruses shown here. Our results illustrate that (i) the reporter system was effective in a quantitative way for all viruses analyzed; (ii) the process of LDA formation showed consistency among herpesviruses; (iii) the impairment of viral kinase activity, responsible for lamin A/C Ser22 phosphorylation, significantly reduced LDA formation; and (iv) inhibitory small molecules, directed either to the viral nuclear egress complex or the cellular isomerase activity, likewise provide an LDA-blocking effect leading to strong antiviral efficacy. Thus, the autofluorescent reporter cell model provides manifold options to study herpesviral productive replication, nuclear host interaction, and the pathogenesis-related impact of regulatory factors.

Undertreatment of Wernicke encephalopathy in alcohol-related clinical contexts: a scoping review of diagnosis, thiamine regimens, and clinical management
abstractText: Abstract Background Wernicke encephalopathy (WE) is a potentially reversible neurological emergency that remains frequently missed and undertreated in patients with alcohol use disorder (AUD). Although thiamine is widely accepted as the cornerstone of prevention and treatment, diagnostic uncertainty, limited comparative evidence, and heterogeneous clinical recommendations contribute to substantial variability in real-world management. This scoping review aimed to map the available evidence on the diagnosis and clinical management of WE in patients with AUD or clinically significant alcohol use, with particular attention to practice variability, undertreatment, and clinically actionable gaps in care. Methods We conducted a scoping review in accordance with PRISMA-ScR guidance. Electronic databases and trial registries were searched for studies addressing the diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of WE in populations with AUD or clinically significant alcohol use. Eligible sources included randomized controlled trials, observational studies, clinical audits, and implementation-focused reports. Data were charted and synthesized thematically. Results A total of 26 studies were included. The evidence base was limited and heterogeneous. Only two randomized controlled trials evaluated thiamine regimens, and no consensus emerged regarding optimal dosing. Diagnostic criteria for WE varied widely across studies, with inconsistent use of formal criteria such as the Caine criteria. Across observational studies and prescribing audits, undertreatment was consistently reported, including delayed initiation of therapy and frequent use of oral thiamine in high-risk scenarios. Studies describing more protocolized and guideline-concordant care more often reported earlier treatment initiation and use of parenteral thiamine in suspected or confirmed cases. Conclusions WE remains underrecognized and undertreated in AUD and clinically significant alcohol use. The mapped evidence suggests that diagnostic uncertainty, limited trial data, and inconsistent implementation of recommendations are associated with persistent variability in care. Although the optimal thiamine regimen remains unresolved, early recognition and appropriate parenteral treatment in high-risk or suspected cases represent actionable opportunities to reduce preventable neurological morbidity.

title: KEPEMIMPINAN KEPALA SEKOLAH, FUNGSI MANAJERIAL, DAN PENGELOLAAN SARANA PRASARANA TERHADAP IKLIM SEKOLAH DASAR
abstractText: ABSTRACT School climate reflects the quality of the social and organizational environment in educational institutions and is associated with leadership, managerial functions, and the management of educational facilities. The relationships among these three aspects require integrated examination to understand the factors contributing to school climate. This study aims to analyze the relationship of principal leadership with managerial functions and educational facility management, the relationship between managerial functions and educational facility management, and the contributions of these three variables to school climate in Janapria District. A quantitative approach with an explanatory survey design was employed. Data were collected through a five-point Likert-scale questionnaire administered to 150 respondents from 15 schools, comprising 5 Islamic elementary schools (Madrasah Ibtidaiyah) and 10 public elementary schools. Data were analyzed using simple and multiple linear regression with IBM SPSS Statistics 26. The results indicate that principal leadership is positively and significantly associated with managerial functions (β = 0.828; p < 0.001) and educational facility management (β = 0.801; p < 0.001). Managerial functions are also positively and significantly associated with educational facility management (β = 0.920; p < 0.001). Simultaneously, the three variables explain 78.4% of the variation in school climate. However, educational facility management does not make a statistically significant partial contribution to school climate (β = 0.144; p = 0.095). These findings highlight the statistical contributions of principal leadership and managerial functions in explaining school climate. ABSTRAK Iklim sekolah mencerminkan kualitas lingkungan sosial dan organisasi pendidikan, yang berkaitan dengan kepemimpinan, pelaksanaan fungsi manajerial, serta pengelolaan sarana dan prasarana. Namun, keterkaitan ketiga aspek tersebut dengan iklim sekolah masih perlu dikaji secara terpadu dalam konteks sekolah dasar. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis hubungan kepemimpinan kepala sekolah dengan fungsi manajerial dan pengelolaan sarana prasarana, hubungan fungsi manajerial dengan pengelolaan sarana prasarana, serta kontribusi ketiga variabel terhadap iklim sekolah di Kecamatan Janapria. Data diperoleh melalui kuesioner skala Likert lima tingkat dari 150 responden pada 15 sekolah, yang terdiri atas 5 Madrasah Ibtidaiyah dan 10 Sekolah Dasar Negeri. Data dianalisis menggunakan regresi linear sederhana dan regresi linear berganda dengan bantuan IBM SPSS Statistics 26. Hasil menunjukkan bahwa kepemimpinan kepala sekolah berhubungan positif dan signifikan dengan fungsi manajerial (β = 0,828; p < 0,001; R² = 0,799) serta pengelolaan sarana prasarana (β = 0,801; p < 0,001; R² = 0,714). Namun, pengelolaan sarana prasarana tidak menunjukkan kontribusi parsial yang signifikan terhadap iklim sekolah (β = 0,144; p = 0,095). Temuan ini menegaskan kontribusi statistik kepemimpinan dan fungsi manajerial dalam menjelaskan iklim sekolah, sekaligus menunjukkan perlunya kajian lanjutan mengenai peran pengelolaan fasilitas dalam model yang melibatkan berbagai aspek pengelolaan sekolah.

title: A Weighted Hybrid Filtering Approach for Cold-Start and Diversity Evaluation in Culinary Recommender Systems
abstractText: Recommender systems play a crucial role in helping users discover relevant and diverse products tailored to their preferences. However, challenges such as the cold-start problem and low recommendation diversity still persist, particularly in single-approach models such as Content-Based Filtering (CBF) and Collaborative Filtering (CF). This study implements and evaluates a Weighted Hybrid Filtering approach that linearly combines prediction scores from CBF, which recommends items based on content similarity to a user's preference profile, and CF, which recommends items based on rating patterns from similar users, using a weighting parameter α. The model was evaluated on a real-world transaction dataset from Tantri Point of Sale (POS) consisting of more than 300,000 user–item interactions, with a user–item interaction sparsity of 99.93%, using Precision@10, Recall@10, F1@10, Intra-List Diversity (ILD@10), RMSE, and MAE. Cold-start conditions were assessed through simulation by masking user interaction histories. Results show that the hybrid configuration with α = 0.9 achieves the highest Recall@10 (0.8153) among all evaluated models, along with an F1@10 of 0.6634, an ILD@10 of 0.8030, an RMSE of 0.2984, and an MAE of 0.1924, although the standalone CF model attains higher F1@10 and ILD@10, and the standalone CBF model attains higher precision, individually. Compared to existing weighted hybrid recommender approaches, which have primarily been evaluated on non-culinary benchmark datasets, this study applies and evaluates the method on a large-scale, real-world culinary transaction dataset, providing an explicit assessment of the accuracy–diversity trade-off across multiple weighting configurations. These findings provide empirical insight into the trade-offs of weighted hybrid filtering for cold-start and diversity assessment in culinary recommender systems.

title: Pengaruh Penggunaan Artificial Intelligence Perpajakan dan Literasi Digital terhadap Kepatuhan Wajib Pajak Gen Z: Kajian Literatur Sistematis
abstractText: The rise of digital technology has helped the modernization of the tax system through Artificial Intelligence (AI) and digital-based tax services. Generation Z, as a cohort that has grown up in the digital era, is expected to adapt to these advances which would improve tax compliance. The present study intends to assess the influence of the application of Artificial Intelligence in taxes and digital literacy on the compliance of Generation Z taxpayers through a systematic literature review approach. The research strategy employed is the Systematic Literature Review (SLR) by assessing five relevant scientific articles published in the year 2022-2026. The results of the study reveal that there has not been a consistent direct effect of AI and tax digitization on taxpayer compliance. Conversely, digital literacy has been identified as a critical factor to improve taxpayers’ awareness, access and utilization of digital tax services. Tax literacy and tax socialization are other supporting elements that increase the relationship between tax technology and taxpayer compliance. These results demonstrate that the effective adoption of AI in taxation is not only based on the technological sophistication but also on the level of digital literacy and tax understanding of users. Thus, there is a need for a strategy that include technology advancement, greater digital literacy, and tax education to promote sustainable compliance among Generation Z taxpayers.

title: OPTIMALISASI SINTA DAN GARUDA UNTUK MENGINTEGRASIKAN SERTA MENINGKATKAN SKOR PUBLIKASI DOSEN DI STISNU NUSANTARA TANGERANG

title: Salidroside alleviates LPS-induced inflammatory injury in MAC-T cells by promoting mitophagy and improving mitochondrial function via the AMPK/mTOR pathway
abstractText: Abstract Mastitis severely impairs dairy production, and lipopolysaccharide (LPS), a major endotoxin, induces mitochondrial dysfunction and inflammatory injury in bovine mammary epithelial cells (BMECs). Mitophagy, which is regulated by the AMPK/mTOR axis, removes damaged mitochondria to restrict excessive inflammation. Although salidroside (SAL) has anti-inflammatory activity, whether it protects against LPS-triggered inflammatory injury in mammary epithelial cells via this pathway remains unclear. Here, we investigated the protective effects of SAL on LPS-stimulated MAC-T cells. Pretreatment with 200 μM SAL markedly reduced the secretion of proinflammatory cytokines (TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1β, and IL-18) induced by 5 μg/mL LPS. Mechanistically, SAL maintained mitochondrial function by restoring ATP levels, restoring mitochondrial membrane potential, and inhibiting abnormal mPTP opening. Moreover, SAL increased the LC3B-II/I ratio and Beclin-1 expression and promoted p62 degradation. Tandem mRFP-GFP-LC3 assays verified that SAL restored functional autophagic flux; moreover, SAL upregulated PINK1 and Parkin expression, indicating mitophagy activation. The results of inhibition experiments demonstrated that 3-methyladenine or cyclosporin A eliminated the protective effects of SAL. The inhibition of AMPK by Compound C blocked SAL-induced mitophagy and reversed its beneficial effects on mitochondrial homeostasis and inflammation. In summary, SAL protected MAC-T cells against LPS-induced inflammatory injury in an AMPK/mTOR-dependent manner by driving PINK1/Parkin-mediated mitophagy to eliminate damaged mitochondria and maintain mitochondrial homeostasis.

abstractText: Divisi General Affair (GA) PT XYZ menghadapi tiga kendala utama dalam mengelola armada operasional: konfirmasi ketersediaan kendaraan yang masih verbal (5–15 menit), data master dan riwayat operasional yang tersebar di file Excel dan formulir kertas, serta proses persetujuan peminjaman berbasis dokumen fisik (2–5 hari kerja) tanpa pelacakan status. title: PENINGKATAN KREATIVITAS DIGITAL MELALUI PEMANFAATAN GENERATIVE AI BERBASIS CLOUD COMPUTING
abstractText: Kegiatan Pengabdian kepada Masyarakat (PkM) ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kreativitas digital siswa melalui pemanfaatan Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI) berbasis cloud computing di SMK Ikhlas Jawilan. Pelatihan difokuskan pada pengenalan konsep dasar Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, dan cloud computing, serta praktik pemanfaatan platform PartyRock dalam menghasilkan aplikasi sederhana dan konten visual berbasis AI. Metode pelaksanaan menggunakan pendekatan experiential learning sehingga peserta memperoleh pengalaman belajar secara langsung dalam mengembangkan karya digital. Evaluasi kegiatan dilakukan melalui pengukuran pada tahap pra dan pasca pelatihan terhadap indikator partisipasi peserta, pemahaman AI dan cloud computing, kemampuan praktik, kreativitas digital, kepercayaan diri, kolaborasi, respons sekolah, serta keberlanjutan pemanfaatan teknologi. Hasil evaluasi menunjukkan bahwa seluruh indikator mengalami peningkatan setelah pelatihan, dengan nilai rata-rata meningkat dari 77,88% pada tahap pra pelatihan menjadi 91,13% pada tahap pasca pelatihan. Capaian pasca pelatihan berada pada kisaran 88-95%, yang menunjukkan peningkatan pada aspek pengetahuan, keterampilan, dan sikap peserta dalam memanfaatkan Generative AI. Hasil tersebut menunjukkan bahwa pelatihan berhasil meningkatkan pemahaman, keterampilan kreativitas digital serta kesiapan peserta dalam memanfaatkan teknologi AI secara produktif dan bertanggung jawab. Selain memberikan manfaat bagi siswa, kegiatan ini juga membantu guru dalam memperluas wawasan terkait pemanfaatan teknologi AI sebagai media pendukung pembelajaran yang inovatif dan adaptif terhadap perkembangan teknologi modern. Secara keseluruhan, kegiatan PkM ini berkontribusi positif dan memiliki potensi untuk dikembangkan sebagai program pelatihan berkelanjutan guna memperkuat literasi digital, mendorong inovasi pembelajaran, serta mengoptimalkan pemanfaatan teknologi Generative AI di lingkungan sekolah.

title: Optical Torque Reversal via Electric-Magnetic Spin-Channel Selection
abstractText: Abstract Light carrying spin angular momentum (SAM) can exert optical torque and drive particles into rotational motion. Although optical torque reversal has been achieved by tailoring particle properties or incident field parameters, the respective roles of the electric and magnetic components of transverse SAM in governing the torque on an isotropic particle remain unresolved. Here, reversible control of the out of plane optical torque on an absorbing isotropic Mie sphere is demonstrated in interference fields formed by two or three plane waves. Two orthogonal linear polarization states selectively activate torque pathways mediated by the electric and magnetic components of the transverse SAM, while intermediate polarization states allow both pathways to coexist. Notably, polarization controls the optical torque by tuning the relative weights of electric and magnetic multipolar contributions. Once higher order Mie channels become appreciable, competition among these contributions can reverse the total torque and switch the particle rotation between clockwise and counterclockwise directions. These results reveal distinct mechanical roles of the electric and magnetic components of transverse SAM and establish spin channel selection as a mechanism for polarization controlled optical torque reversal.

Evaluasi Penerapan Kriteria Bangunan Gedung Hijau pada Gedung Kantor Balai Besar Wilayah Sungai Sumatera II Medan
abstractText: Existing government office buildings often have no record of green building performance, and the cost of improving it is rarely estimated. This study evaluated the green building performance of the Balai Besar Wilayah Sungai (BBWS) Sumatera II Medan office building at the utilization stage, identified the improvements needed to reach the lowest rating (Pratama), and estimated their cost. The assessment used the checklist of Minister of Public Works and Housing Regulation No. 21 of 2021 and Circular Letter No. 01/SE/M/2022, with field observation, interviews with the building management, and official documents. Costs were calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price, using the Medan unit price standard and the government e-catalogue. The building scored 15.92 of 165 points (9.65%) and did not reach any rating. Missing documents, written policies, and consumption monitoring were the main sources of lost points. Managerial improvements, together with technical modifications to air conditioners, sanitary fixtures, and waste bins, would raise the score to 76.32 points (46.25%), which meets the Pratama rating. The technical modifications were estimated at IDR 690,059,339, about 81% of which is air conditioner replacement. These results give the management a scored and costed basis for budget planning.

title: Acrylic fibres do not affect nest building or incubation in laboratory zebra finches
abstractText: Abstract As synthetic materials have rapidly accumulated in the environment over the past decades, birds have increasingly incorporated them into their nests. However, it is not clear whether such materials affect the nest’s insulative properties, a builder’s behaviour and/or the hatching success of its clutch. Here, we used laboratory-bred zebra finches Taeniopygia guttata to test whether the use of synthetic fibres (acrylic yarn) as nesting material: (i) changes nest building and incubation behaviours and/or (ii), alters the insulation properties of a nest and whether any of these ultimately (iii) influence the hatching success of the builder’s eggs. We saw no impact of acrylic yarn on any of these variables relative to nests built with non-synthetic wool fibres. The main driver of hatching success was, instead, the degree to which parents managed to keep their clutch warm by attending their nest during incubation. Our results demonstrate that nests entirely built with either synthetically-produced or naturally-derived fibres do not necessarily differ in their insulation properties. It is therefore possible that the inclusion of some types of synthetic material into a nest is not always detrimental to the builder or their offspring.

title: Double Cavity Exceptional Point Enhanced Laser Cooling of Semiconductors
abstractText: Abstract Laser cooling of semiconductors requires a high external quantum efficiency for phonon-assisted upconversion while suppressing heat generated by background absorption and non-radiative relaxation. Nanophotonic resonances can strengthen the upconversion channel, but in a single-mode structure may also enhance parasitic pump heating. We introduce a two-cavity non-Hermitian architecture that separates preparation of a lower reservoir state from extraction of the phonon-promoted radiative state. A passive exceptional point, containing no optical gain, is placed in the output branch, where it reshapes the projected final-state optical response; all anti-Hermitian diagonal terms describe radiative leakage, internal absorption, or material decay. For a CdS parameter set, the four-mode calculation gives a 1.23 × 10 3 enhancement of upconverted photoluminescence (UCPL) relative to a single-mode control, while the pump-induced heat load rises by only 2.8×10 -3 %. The gain consists of a factor of 3.45×10 2 from the independent output resonance and a further factor of 3.56 from exceptional-point tuning.

title: Potential Health Benefits of Piceatannol-Rich Extracts from Passiflora edulis f. flavicarpa Seeds on Modulating Gene Expressions Related to Fat Metabolism and Muscle Development in C2C12 Myotubes
abstractText: Abstract Yellow passion fruits are widely cultivated in many countries. Throughout industrial manufacturing operations, seeds are frequently disposed of as byproducts. Passion fruit seeds are an abundant natural source of piceatannol, which is known for its antioxidant properties and its ability to modulate protein turnover. This study investigated the potential benefits of passion fruit (PF) extract from pulp and juice, as well as piceatannol-rich (PIC) extract from passion fruit seeds, on palmitic acid (PA)-induced myosteatosis-related muscle atrophy in C2C12 myotubes at the transcriptional level. The PIC extract yielded 5.1% (w/w) with a piceatannol concentration of 0.37% (w/w). The result showed that the PIC extract was more effective in free radical scavenging than the piceatannol standard. Additionally, the results demonstrated that PA promoted lipid accumulation while impairing the muscle formation and glucose absorption. However, both PF and PIC extracts demonstrated a significant reduction in PA-induced lipid accumulation, accompanied by suppression of diacylglycerol acyltransferase 1 (Dgat1) expression without altering sirtuin 1 (Sirt1) and uncoupling protein 3 (Ucp3). In addition, both extracts tended to enhance the expression of myosin heavy chain 1 (Myh1) and glucose transporter type 4 (GLUT4), while markedly reducing myostatin (Mstn) expression, suggesting improvements in muscle development and glucose uptake. Furthermore, the PIC extract suppressed pancreatic lipase activity, which minimizes spikes in postprandial triglycerides in the blood circulation of rats. These findings emphasize the potential health benefits of PF and PIC extracts in enhancing glucose absorption and inhibiting fat synthesis in C2C12 myotubes, suggesting potential to mitigate lipid accumulation-related muscle development. The promising findings from cell culture suggest further in vivo investigation for studying their physiological relevance to muscle wasting caused by fat accumulation in obesity.

title: Taxonomic clarifications of Homalomena hainanensis and Schismatoglottis hainanensis, with floristic notes on the Araceae family in Hainan Island
abstractText: Summary Homalomena hainanensis H.Li and Schismatoglottis hainanensis H.Li, two historically enigmatic aroid names published from Hainan Island, have long presented taxonomic ambiguity due to unclear protologues and poorly preserved type materials. Through careful examinations of the types and new materials from recent fieldwork, the identities of both names are clarified with new interpretations. Homalomena hainanensis is epitypified here, with the recently published H. perplexa K.Z.Hein, Vuang, Bao & V.S.Dang placed in synonymy, and Schismatoglottis hainanensis is shown to be conspecific with the Central Vietnamese S. cadierei Buchet & Gagnep. ex S.Y.Wong & P.C.Boyce. We also confirm the occurrence of Anadendrum chlorospathum V.D.Nguyen, Đinh & P.C.Boyce in Hainan for the first time, resolving a long history of misidentification. These taxonomic clarifications, together with literature and herbarium records, reveal an Indochina–Hainan disjunct distribution for these three species and highlight the tropical, low-endemism aroid flora of Hainan, whose close affinity with that of Vietnam supports a continental origin and suggests geologically recent eustatic floristic exchanges.

title: Exploring the potential of eri silkworm (Samia ricini) in addressing food and feed security
abstractText: Abstract Inclusion of edible insects in dietary spectrum can promote ecological balance and support social equity by providing locally produced, nutrient-rich food and feed. Insects like eri ( Samia ricini ), contain great amount of protein, fat, crude fibre, minerals, and vitamins at various developmental stages. Silk industry waste eri pupae can be effectively used to combat malnutrition by utilising as a food source alternative to conventional sources. This review focuses on providing comprehensive overview of recent studies on eri silkworm pupae as a food and feed source, covering rearing to its food applications. It attempts to highlight the nutrient composition of eri silkworm and factors influencing it, processing practices and preparation methods for human consumption, the health-promoting potential of the nutrients and bioactive peptides present in it, product innovations and their consumer acceptance, utility of eri in feed for aquaculture and poultry. The researchers have mentioned that eri pupae are abundant in essential amino acids, ω -3 polyunsaturated fatty acids, vitamins B and E, along with many minerals. These compositions could vary based on extrinsic factors and intrinsic factors like host plant, strain, metamorphosis stage, and sex. Innovative products like candy, tofu, ice cream, made with eri protein and flour were reported to have good sensory acceptance. The expectations are expressed that the nutrients and bioactive peptides of eri would contribute to health-benefiting functions like anti-inflammatory, cardioprotective, neuroprotective, anti-diabetic, etc. As animal feed too, it can improve the growth performance without compromising animal health.

Strategic Formulation of Digital Literacy Learning in Indonesian Elementary Education: A SWOT-AHP Approach
abstractText: The implementation of digital literacy in Indonesian elementary schools is essential for 21st-century education, yet it faces persistent challenges in teacher competence, infrastructure availability, and curriculum integration. This study aims to develop prioritized digital literacy strategies for elementary schools in Indonesia based on a comprehensive analysis of internal and external factors. A sequential mixed methods approach was used. The qualitative phase involved focus group discussions and interviews with 71 educators and experts, selected through purposive sampling, to identify Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, and Threats (SWOT). The quantitative phase applied the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) with eight key experts to weigh the SWOT factors and the resulting alternative strategies. The SWOT analysis identified high student motivation and potential for developing 21st-century skills as key strengths; limited teacher pedagogical and technological competence and limited access to infrastructure as major weaknesses; government support and digital learning resources as main opportunities; and cybersecurity and disinformation as serious threats. The AHP results showed that Opportunities had the highest priority (weight 0.385), followed by Weaknesses (0.310). The priority strategies were: (1) improving teacher competence through continuous training (WO1, 0.350); (2) developing students' critical thinking skills (ST2, 0.330); (3) leveraging students' enthusiasm for learning innovation (SO1, 0.320); and (4) simultaneously improving teacher competence and students' digital ethics awareness (WT2, 0.300). These findings offer actionable priorities to guide national efforts in advancing digital literacy at the elementary level.

title: When AI Delegation Becomes Dependence: Administrative Judgment at Risk
abstractText: Public organizations can delegate cognitive work to artificial intelligence while losing the capacity to scrutinize or resume that work. When does useful delegation become institutional dependence? This article develops a theory of institutional AI dependence as a task–role–workflow configuration combining substantial delegation of core cognition with insufficient task-required review or recovery capacity. It distinguishes two vulnerabilities: inadequate challenge during AI-supported work and inadequate capacity to continue judgment-intensive work when the system is unavailable. Extensive delegation with adequate distributed expertise and tested recovery constitutes managed delegation. Integrating cognitive offloading, automation, organizational learning, and public-administration research, the article extends Song et al.’s (2026) account of epistemic authority to organizational workflows and distinguishes perceived credibility from procedural authority embedded in defaults and override rules. Seven propositions connect practice displacement, challenge behavior, knowledge retention, subsequent delegation, and responsibility–control alignment. They specify how task-relevant practice, diagnostic feedback, and transferable knowledge shape retained capacity over time. The contribution is a task-relative diagnosis of threatened administrative judgment and a set of testable formation mechanisms. The framework guides public organizations in governing current agentic systems and preparing review and recovery arrangements for more capable AI.

title: Estrategias metacognitivas para la comprensión de procesos de resolución de problemas en matemática de los estudiantes de 7mo grado de EGB
abstractText: This research aimed to propose a didactic guide based on metacognitive strategies to improve the understanding of mathematical problem-solving processes among 7th-grade students at the "Ecuador" Basic Education School. The proposal addresses the need to strengthen students' critical and reflective thinking, given that metacognition fosters the planning, monitoring, and evaluation of one's own learning. The study employed a quantitative approach with a descriptive scope and a non-experimental, cross-sectional design. A survey of teachers was used as the data collection method to understand their perceptions regarding the use of metacognitive strategies and the difficulties students face in solving mathematical problems. The results showed that while most teachers recognize the importance of applying metacognitive strategies, they do not always have clear tools or methodologies for integrating them into the classroom. Additionally, it was identified that students struggle particularly with the planning and verification of solutions. Based on these findings, a didactic guide structured around metacognitive phases was designed, aimed at significantly improving the mathematics teaching-learning process.

title: PENDAMPINGAN PENULISAN PROPOSAL HIBAH PENELITIAN KEMDIKTISAINTEK BAGI DOSEN UNIVERSITAS TRILOGI
abstractText: Rendahnya tingkat keberhasilan proposal hibah penelitian sering kali disebabkan oleh lemahnya struktur penulisan, kurangnya argumentasi berbasis bukti, serta ketidakmampuan peneliti dalam mengomunikasikan kontribusi ilmiah dan dampak penelitian secara meyakinkan. Kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kapasitas dosen dan peneliti perguruan tinggi dalam menyusun proposal hibah penelitian Kemdiktisaintek yang berkualitas dan kompetitif. Metode pelaksanaan kegiatan menggunakan pendekatan workshop berbasis praktik dan pendampingan intensif, yang meliputi pemaparan materi, praktik penulisan proposal, review berbasis rubrik reviewer, serta klinik proposal. Evaluasi kegiatan dilakukan menggunakan instrumen pre-test dan post-test untuk mengukur peningkatan pemahaman peserta. Hasil evaluasi menunjukkan adanya peningkatan skor rata-rata peserta dari 3,32 pada pre-test menjadi 4,80 pada post-test, yang mengindikasikan peningkatan pemahaman yang signifikan. Peningkatan tersebut terutama terlihat pada pemahaman struktur proposal, penyusunan evidence-based argument, serta kemampuan mengomunikasikan kontribusi dan dampak penelitian. Berdasarkan hasil tersebut, dapat disimpulkan bahwa kegiatan pelatihan dan pendampingan ini efektif dalam meningkatkan kesiapan dan kompetensi peserta dalam menyusun proposal hibah penelitian. Kegiatan ini diharapkan dapat berkontribusi pada peningkatan kualitas dan kuantitas proposal penelitian serta penguatan budaya riset di Universitas Trilogi.

title: Effect of Filler Conductive Threshold on Cathodic Protection and Anticorrosion Mechanism of Zinc-rich Epoxy Coatings
abstractText: Abstract In this study, reduced graphene oxide (rGO) fillers with electrical conductivities spanning nearly five orders of magnitude (4.2 × 10–4 – 20.58 S/cm) were prepared by hydrothermal reduction and incorporated at a fixed loading of 0.5 wt % into zinc-rich epoxy coatings containing 50 wt % zinc powder. The influence of the reduction-dependent rGO state on coating structure, interfacial properties, cathodic protection, and corrosion resistance was systematically evaluated. A non-monotonic conductivity–performance relationship was observed, with rGO160 (1.62 S/cm) showing the best overall protection under the present formulation. XPS and FTIR revealed that rGO160 retained an intermediate surface polarity, while cross-sectional SEM and mechanical tests indicated a dense coating structure, reduced interfacial defects, and the highest pull-off adhesion strength (∼6.4 MPa). KPFM further showed a comparatively uniform contact-potential-difference distribution. After 30 days of immersion, the MZrZE-rGO160 coating retained the highest low-frequency impedance modulus (|Z|0.01Hz ≈ 4 × 107 Ω·cm2) and exhibited the lowest relative corrosion propagation after 300 h of salt-spray exposure. DFT calculations showed comparatively less favorable H2O and O2 adsorption on the idealized rGO160 surface (+0.03 and +0.61 eV, respectively), serving as supplementary thermodynamic descriptors rather than direct kinetic evidence. The results demonstrate that the optimum protection arises from the coupled balance of conductivity, surface chemistry, sheet dispersion/restacking, conductive-network connectivity, and coating integrity. Accordingly, 1.62 S cm–1 should be regarded as a formulation-dependent optimum among the investigated rGO fillers rather than a universal conductivity threshold.

title: Perbedaan Minat Beli Hunian Berbasis Transportasi Berdasarkan Usia, Pendapatan dan Investasi di Jabodetabek
abstractText: Pasar properti urban di Indonesia khusunya area Jabodetabek mengalami pergeseran paradigma akibat kebutuhan akan hunian yang terintegrasi dengan moda transportasi massal. Pengembang properti dalam menanggapi tren ini mengembangkan hunian yang terintegrasi dengan transportasi publik atau yang dikenal dengan Transit Oriented Development (TOD). Namun, masalah utama masih terkait dengan pemahaman tentang niat pembelian konsumen yang masih kurang berdasarkan demografi & behavioral. Dengan menggabungkan variabel demografi (usia dan penghasilan) dan variabel behavioral (manfaat terhadap investasi) ke dalam model analisa prediksi yang didasarkan pada Social Cognitive Theory didukung Theory of Planned Behavior menggunakan formula Lemeshow yang dikalkulasi serta digambarkan dengan grafik Anova, dimana penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menemukan mekanisme kognitif yang memengaruhi niat beli hunian berkonsep TOD. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan sampel penelitian terdiri atas konsumen aktual dan prospektif dari lima proyek TOD khususnya di area stasiun LRT di Jabodetabek pada kuartal I 2026. Hasil penelitian ini diharapkan menunjukkan pola kognitif berbeda antar segmen usia, lapisan pendapatan dan nilai investasi terhadap minat beli properti TOD. Temuan utamanya akan memperjelas segmen konsumen mana yang paling responsif terhadap personalisasi strategi pemasaran dan merekomendasikan langkah praktis bagi pengembang hunian TOD pada umumnya, untuk meningkatkan omset penjualan dan variabel dasar apa yang harus diperhatikan untuk purchase intention customer. Selain memberikan kontribusi teoretis berupa integrasi Social Cognitive Theory didukung Theory of Planned Behavior dengan teknik prediktif dalam riset properti, penelitian ini juga menghadirkan kerangka kerja segmentasi yang aplikatif bagi pengembang lain di Indonesia. Dengan demikian, temuan ini tidak hanya menambah literatur mengenai Analisa Prediksi di real estate, tetapi juga mendukung implementasi strategi pemasaran berbasis data yang lebih efisien.

title: Batu Seremban sebagai Konteks Etnomatematika Melayu dalam Pembelajaran Deep Learning untuk Mental Calculation
abstractText: Mental calculation is an important part of numeracy competence because it relates to number understanding, strategy flexibility, and the ability to use number relationships in solving arithmetic operations. Learning that only emphasizes written algorithms can limit opportunities to explore diverse calculation strategies. This article aims to develop a conceptual study on the use of the Batu Seremban game as a Malay ethnomathematics context integrated with a deep learning approach to support mental calculation of elementary school students in Phase B on addition and subtraction. The study uses a conceptual literature review approach by synthesizing literature on ethnomathematics, traditional games, contextual mathematics learning, deep learning, number sense, and mental calculation. Five stones are given pedagogical values based on learning agreements, namely red=1, yellow=2, green=3, blue=4, and black=5. The conceptual synthesis shows that Batu Seremban activities can be used to facilitate combining, separating, decomposing, compensation, and inverse relationships between addition and subtraction. The integration of meaningful, mindful, and joyful learning principles has the potential to strengthen meaning and student engagement. This study produces a conceptual framework as a basis for developing learning tools rooted in local wisdom.

title: Boosting Carrier Mobility and Restoring Ambipolarity in 2D TMD Transistors via Nano-spherical Probe Cleaning
abstractText: Abstract Two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), particularly MoS2 and WSe2, are ideal candidates for constructing next-generation high-performance electronics due to their atomic thickness and excellent electrical tunability. However, interface contaminants and bubbles inevitably introduced during device fabrication remain a critical challenge, acting as scattering centers that severely limit carrier mobility and induce device instability. This study demonstrates an in situ mechanical contact strategy using a nano-spherical probe to precisely remove interface residues in MoS2/hBN and WSe2/hBN van der Waals heterostructures. Experimental results indicate that this method significantly reduces interface roughness from ∼11.5 to ∼1.35 nm. The cleaned MoS2 field-effect transistors (FETs) exhibited a significant increase in effective electron mobility from ∼8.5 to 79.2 cm2/V·s, an improvement of approximately one order of magnitude in the on/off ratio, and a significant suppression of charge-trapping-induced hysteresis. For WSe2 devices, the technique successfully restored intrinsic symmetric ambipolar transport characteristics, enhancing both electron and hole drive currents. Furthermore, a 90-day monitoring period in a non-vacuum environment revealed the different degradation mechanisms of interface adsorbates on n-type and p-type carrier transport. This work not only confirms the universality of nanomechanical cleaning technology in enhancing the intrinsic performance of 2D material heterostructure devices but also deeply elucidates the structure–property relationship regarding long-term stability, providing guidance for the interface engineering of high-performance 2D electronics.

CHH demethylation of the BcMAM1 promoter contributes to cold tolerance in autotetraploid wucai ( Brassica campestris L.)
abstractText: Abstract Polyploidization has long been recognized as a driving force in plant adaptation to adverse environments. Chilling injury poses a major challenge to global crop production, and the regulatory hierarchies that govern cold adaptation in polyploid crops are unexplored. Here, we show that tetraploid wucai (Brassica campestris L.) displays greater cold tolerance than its diploid counterpart. Under prolonged cold stress, tetraploid plants displayed enhanced glucosinolate-associated transcriptional and metabolic responses, which may contribute to their improved stress adaptation. At the epigenetic level, diploid and tetraploid wucai showed distinct DNA methylation responses to short-term cold, with diploid plants tending toward greater CHH hypermethylation in promoter regions. This ploidy-specific increase in methylation correlates with transcriptional repression of multiple stress-responsive loci in diploids. Notably, expression of the glucosinolate biosynthesis gene METHYLTHIOALKYLMALATE SYNTHASE1 (BcMAM1) diverged between ploidies after cold treatment, inversely correlating with opposing CHH methylation (H = A, C, or T) trends in its promoter. Pharmacological demethylation using 5-azacytidine upregulated BcMAM1 and improved cold tolerance. Through a combination of functional assays and promoter-binding analyses, we identify the upstream transcription factor C-REPEAT BINDING FACTOR4 (BcCBF4), which binds to differentially methylated regions within the BcMAM1 promoter in a methylation-sensitive manner, supporting an association between the epigenetic state and transcriptional output. Together, our findings support a mechanistic model for the distinct cold response observed in the autotetraploid wucai line, involving coordinated changes in transcriptional activation and DNA methylation dynamics. The epigenetic and transcriptional targets identified in this study may inform breeding strategies for cold-resilient crops.

title: Actividades en Educaplay para el desarrollo de las habilidades lectoras en los estudiantes de cuarto año EGB.
abstractText: The development of reading activities is a fundamental pillar for academic success and personal growth in today's educational context. The objective of this study was to propose an activity blog on the Educaplay platform. The methodology adopts a quantitative approach, based on empirical-deductive logic, employing rigorous methods and statistical techniques for data collection and analysis. The applied field study design was geared towards solving a practical problem, with a population of 3 teachers and 28 fourth-grade students. The instruments used were a Likert-scale survey administered to teachers and an observation checklist for students. The results demonstrate significant improvements in students' basic reading skills, highlighting the potential of the Educaplay activity blog to motivate learning and, in turn, improve reading comprehension. In conclusion, the appropriate pedagogical design of interactive activities can be an effective tool for overcoming these deficiencies and fostering outstanding learning.

title: Public Service Motivation, Formal Control Strength, and Incentive Consistency: Civil Servant Performance Patterns in Yogyakarta
abstractText: This study examines how public service motivation (PSM), formal control strength (FCS), and performance incentive consistency (PIC) relate to civil servant performance patterns in two local government agencies in the Special Region of Yogyakarta, Indonesia. Employing a qualitative embedded multiple-case study design, data were collected through semi-structured interviews with 12 informants and a review of performance-related documents. The data were analyzed using cross-case thematic analysis guided by an interpretive configurational perspective. The findings identify three configurations: two associated with relatively favorable performance and one indicating shortcomings in task execution. PSM may differentiate performance patterns, while PIC is perceived as an additional motivational factor. However, consistently high FCS across all configurations limits conclusions about its differentiating role. Evidence of low PSM in the third configuration came primarily from one agency and should be interpreted with caution. The findings also suggest possible partial motivational substitution and functional complementarity, although causal relationships cannot be established. Overlapping reporting requirements, resource constraints, and an emphasis on administrative targets further complicate assessments of substantive performance. This study contributes an interpretive configurational explanation of civil servant performance by integrating motivational and institutional conditions. It highlights the practical importance of strengthening service orientation, improving incentive transparency, and evaluating the quality of substantive work beyond administrative target attainment.
